examples.en: We played a finitely repeated game that ended after the fifth round of the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们玩了一个「有限重复博弈」，到课堂练习第五轮结束就停止。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked what the groups would choose in the last round of the finitely repeated game.
examples.zh: 练习表问，各组在「有限重复博弈」的最后一轮会怎样选择。

collocations: identify the last round of a finitely repeated game

words.enDefinition: charging each buyer the maximum that buyer is willing to pay for each unit under the idealised model

examples.en: The hypothetical model illustrated first-degree price discrimination by assigning each purchase its exact maximum willingness to pay.
examples.zh: 假想模型为每次购买设定其最高支付意愿对应的价格，以演示「一级价格歧视」。

examples.en: We discussed why first-degree price discrimination required information that the seller rarely possessed in actual markets.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「一级价格歧视」为什么需要卖家在真实市场里很少掌握的信息。

collocations: compare first-degree price discrimination with uniform pricing

words.enDefinition: a single-item auction in which the highest bidder wins and pays that bidder's own bid

examples.en: The winner of the first-price auction paid the number of tokens written on their own card.
examples.zh: 「第一价格拍卖」的赢者按自己卡片上写的数量支付代币。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the predicted prices changed when the worksheet switched to a first-price auction.
examples.zh: 练习表切换到「第一价格拍卖」后，老师核查了预测价格是否改变。

collocations: compare a first-price auction with a second-price auction
record payments in a first-price auction

words.enDefinition: The regression of an endogenous regressor on the instruments and any included exogenous controls in two-stage least squares.

examples.en: The first-stage regression shows how the simulated offer predicts actual attendance after accounting for prior scores.
examples.zh: 「第一阶段回归」展示控制先前成绩后，模拟邀请如何预测实际出席。

examples.en: We examined the first-stage regression before interpreting the second regression in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在解读课堂示例的第二个回归前，我们先检查「第一阶段回归」。

words.enDefinition: Tax or spending change intended to reduce aggregate spending or activity

examples.en: Our worksheet models a fiscal contraction by reducing public spending when private demand is strong.
examples.zh: 习题用私人需求旺盛时削减公共支出的方法来模拟「财政紧缩」。

examples.en: We discussed the possible effects of a fiscal contraction before changing any other model assumptions.
examples.zh: 调整其他模型假设前，我们讨论了「财政紧缩」可能带来的影响。

words.enDefinition: Tax or spending change intended to increase aggregate spending or activity

examples.en: The model illustrates a fiscal expansion by raising government purchases during weak private spending.
examples.zh: 这个模型展示了私人支出疲弱时增加政府购买支出的「财政扩张」。

examples.en: We compared a tax-based fiscal expansion with a change in government purchases in class.
examples.zh: 全班比较了以税收调整为手段的「财政扩张」和政府购买支出的变化。

words.enDefinition: A quantity index formed as the geometric mean of indexes using earlier-period and later-period prices, respectively.

examples.en: The Fisher quantity index combines the two volume comparisons calculated using different price weights in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 「费雪数量指数」综合了练习中分别采用两组价格权重计算的数量比较结果。

examples.en: We used a Fisher quantity index to connect the two years in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「费雪数量指数」连接示例中的两个年度。

words.enDefinition: An estimator that removes or accounts for group-specific constant effects in a regression, such as unit effects.

examples.en: The fixed effects estimator uses the changes within each school to estimate the association in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「固定效应估计量」利用各校内部的变化估计关联。

examples.en: We compared the fixed effects estimator with one that uses both within and between variation.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「固定效应估计量」与同时利用组内和组间变动的估计量。

words.enDefinition: an input whose quantity cannot be changed during the period being analysed

examples.en: In the short-run example, the oven was a fixed input because adding another would take several months.
examples.zh: 在短期示例中，增设烤炉需要几个月，因此现有烤炉属于「固定投入要素」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which fixed input limited the number of bicycles the workshop could repair each day.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪项「固定投入要素」限制了车间每天能修的自行车数量。

words.enDefinition: a technology in which inputs need to be used in specified proportions to increase output

examples.en: The fixed-proportions technology required one bench for each worker before another unit could be produced.
examples.zh: 按这项「固定比例生产技术」，每名工人都要配一个工作台，产量才能增加。

examples.en: Our tutor used fixed-proportions technology to explain why one unused input alone could add no output.
examples.zh: 导师用「固定比例生产技术」说明为什么单独增加某种尚有余量的投入不会增加产量。

collocations: draw an isoquant for fixed-proportions technology

words.enDefinition: an exchange rate primarily determined by market supply and demand without a predetermined fixed path

examples.en: The floating exchange rate adjusted after a change in demand for the currency in our model economy.
examples.zh: 示例经济体的外汇市场对该货币的需求改变后，「浮动汇率」作出调整。

examples.en: We compared a floating exchange rate with an arrangement that specified a narrow target range in advance.
examples.zh: 我们把「浮动汇率」与预先指定狭窄目标区间的安排作了比较。

collocations: operate with a floating exchange rate
compare fixed and floating exchange rates

words.enDefinition: A result showing that many feasible individually rational payoffs can be sustained in repeated games under suitable conditions.

examples.en: Our tutor used a folk theorem to explain why patient players could sustain several different outcomes.
examples.zh: 老师用一条「民间定理」解释重视未来的参与者为何能维持几种不同结果。

examples.en: The worksheet asked which assumptions were needed before applying the folk theorem to the classroom game.
examples.zh: 练习表问，对课堂博弈使用「民间定理」之前需要哪些假设。

collocations: explain a folk theorem for repeated games
discuss the conditions of a folk theorem

words.enDefinition: cross-border investment involving a lasting relationship and significant influence or control under the statistical definition

examples.en: The example classified an overseas factory acquisition as foreign direct investment because it gave the buyer significant influence.
examples.zh: 示例将收购海外工厂归为「外国直接投资」，因为收购方取得了重大影响力。

examples.en: We compared foreign direct investment with foreign purchases of securities that did not create a direct investment relationship.
examples.zh: 我们把「外国直接投资」与未形成直接投资关系的跨境证券买入作了比较。

words.enDefinition: transactions in currency markets by monetary authorities aimed at influencing the exchange rate or exchange market conditions

examples.en: The report listed foreign exchange intervention separately from commercial currency purchases by large private companies that month.
examples.zh: 报告把「外汇干预」与当月大型私企的商业购汇分开列出。

examples.en: Our tutor explained the purpose of foreign exchange intervention in a historical example with a stated exchange target.
examples.zh: 导师解释了一个有明确汇率目标的历史例子里「外汇干预」的目的。

collocations: explain the objective of foreign exchange intervention

words.enDefinition: the portion of exports' value attributable to production activities in other economies

examples.en: The foreign value added in exports included the value created by overseas suppliers making the electronic components.
examples.zh: 「出口中的国外增加值」包括海外供应商制造电子元件的过程中创造的价值。

examples.en: We estimated foreign value added in exports when the assembly sector used the same imported components repeatedly.
examples.zh: 当装配部门持续使用同一类进口元件时，我们估计了「出口中的国外增加值」。

collocations: estimate foreign value added in exports
calculate the share of foreign value added in exports
identify foreign value added in exports

words.enDefinition: Central bank communication about likely future policy or conditions guiding decisions

examples.en: The committee used forward guidance to explain what data could justify another rate change.
examples.zh: 委员会通过「前瞻指引」说明哪些数据可能支持再次调整利率。

examples.en: Our class analyzed how forward guidance might affect expected short-term rates before policy changes.
examples.zh: 全班分析了政策改变前「前瞻指引」可能如何影响预期短期利率。

words.enDefinition: the combined market share of the four largest firms in a defined market

examples.en: The four-firm concentration ratio increased because the four biggest suppliers captured a larger share of sales.
examples.zh: 最大四家供应商占据了更大销售份额，「四企业集中率」因此上升。

examples.en: We calculated the four-firm concentration ratio before comparing it with a measure that included all sellers.
examples.zh: 我们计算「四企业集中率」，再与计入所有卖家的指标作比较。

collocations: interpret changes in the four-firm concentration ratio

words.enDefinition: Distributing emissions allowances to participants without charging them for the initial allocation.

examples.en: The example used free allocation of permits, but firms could still buy or sell them later.
examples.zh: 例题采用「免费分配排放配额」，之后企业仍可买卖所获配额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how free allocation of permits affected the starting positions of the simulated factories.
examples.zh: 老师问，「免费分配排放配额」怎样影响各模拟工厂的初始条件。

collocations: compare free allocation of permits with auctions
model the effects of free allocation of permits

words.enDefinition: a market condition where producers can join or leave without substantial barriers

examples.en: With free entry and exit, profitable market conditions could attract new firms in the long-run example.
examples.zh: 在长期示例里，由于有「自由进入与退出」，可盈利的市场条件会吸引新厂商。

examples.en: The tutor contrasted free entry and exit with a model requiring extended exclusive rights to supply the service.
examples.zh: 导师把「自由进入与退出」与必须持有长期排他供应权的模型作了比较。

collocations: model a market with free entry and exit

words.enDefinition: Underfunding or underprovision that can result when users benefit from a good without contributing to it.

examples.en: The free-rider problem appeared when households could benefit from the warning service without paying for it.
examples.zh: 家庭不付费也能从预警服务中受益时，出现了「搭便车问题」。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced the free-rider problem before asking why voluntary payments fell short in the example.
examples.zh: 老师先介绍了「搭便车问题」，再问例题中的自愿付款为什么不足。

collocations: show the free-rider problem in a model

words.enDefinition: an arrangement removing duties and other restrictions on substantially all originating trade among members, who retain individual policies toward outsiders

examples.en: The free trade area removed duties among the example members while each retained its own external tariff schedule.
examples.zh: 示例中的「自由贸易区」取消成员之间的关税，各成员保留各自对外关税表。

examples.en: We compared a free trade area with an arrangement that used one shared tariff on outside imports.
examples.zh: 我们把「自由贸易区」与采用统一外部进口关税的安排作了比较。

collocations: compare a free trade area with a customs union

words.enDefinition: a balance of supply and demand when trade is permitted without the trade barriers being analysed

examples.en: In free-trade equilibrium, the quantity traded matched the gap between domestic demand and domestic output in our diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的图里，「自由贸易均衡」时的贸易量等于国内需求与国内产量之间的差额。

examples.en: The tutor used free-trade equilibrium as the benchmark before introducing a tariff in the model.
examples.zh: 导师以「自由贸易均衡」为基准，再向假想模型加入关税。

collocations: compare a tariff outcome with free-trade equilibrium

words.enDefinition: Unemployment while workers and employers take time to find suitable matches

examples.en: The model shows frictional unemployment while graduates look for openings that match their training.
examples.zh: 模型展示了毕业生寻找与培训经历匹配的岗位时发生的「摩擦性失业」。

examples.en: We discussed how a better job board could shorten spells of frictional unemployment.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了更好的招聘信息平台如何缩短「摩擦性失业」的持续时间。

words.enDefinition: the combined output offered by the competitive firms outside a dominant producer in a dominant-firm model

examples.en: The fringe supply increased as smaller producers found ways to make the same service at lower cost.
examples.zh: 较小生产者找到更低成本提供同一服务的方法后，「边缘厂商供给」增加了。

examples.en: We subtracted fringe supply to estimate how much demand remained for the dominant firm at each price.
examples.zh: 我们扣除「边缘厂商供给」，估计各价格下还剩多少需求由主导厂商满足。

collocations: deduct fringe supply from market demand

words.enDefinition: A case in which the buyer's price changes by exactly the change in the tax per unit.

examples.en: The simulation showed full tax pass-through when the buyer price increased by exactly the tax amount.
examples.zh: 买方价格涨幅恰好等于税额时，模拟显示「税收完全转嫁」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which supply conditions could produce full tax pass-through in the simple classroom model.
examples.zh: 老师问，在简单课堂模型中，哪些供给条件可能产生「税收完全转嫁」。

collocations: compare full tax pass-through with incomplete pass-through

words.enDefinition: The mathematical form that specifies how the outcome is related to its regressors.

examples.en: The functional form allows the fitted wage increase to become smaller at higher experience levels.
examples.zh: 这种「函数形式」允许经验水平较高时，工资拟合增量变小。

examples.en: We compared two choices of functional form using the same education data in class.
examples.zh: 我们用相同的教育数据比较了两种「函数形式」的选择。

words.enDefinition: A discontinuity design in which the cutoff changes treatment probability without perfectly determining each unit's treatment status.

examples.en: Fuzzy regression discontinuity fits the example because the cutoff changes participation without fully determining it.
examples.zh: 「模糊断点回归」适用于该示例，因为跨过阈值会改变参加概率，但无法完全决定是否参加。

examples.en: The tutor used fuzzy regression discontinuity to distinguish eligibility from actual participation in the simulation.
examples.zh: 老师用「模糊断点回归」区分模拟中的资格与实际参与。

collocations: participation jump in fuzzy regression discontinuity

words.enDefinition: the increased consumption possibilities or economic surplus made possible by exchanging goods or services

examples.en: The diagram showed gains from trade when each community could obtain more of the goods it valued.
examples.zh: 当各社区能取得更多自己看重的商品时，图中显示了「贸易利得」。

examples.en: We compared aggregate gains from trade with the losses experienced by particular producers in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，我们比较整体「贸易利得」与特定生产者遭受的损失。

words.enDefinition: The sequence of actions and chance events that has occurred along part of a game.

examples.en: The game history recorded which rooms had been proposed and whether each offer was accepted.
examples.zh: 「博弈历史」记录了各方提议过哪些教室，以及每个提议是否被接受。

examples.en: We changed our plan after reading the game history from the earlier rounds of the exercise.
examples.zh: 读过练习前几轮的「博弈历史」后，我们改变了计划。

collocations: condition a move on the game history

words.enDefinition: A game where some payoff-relevant information, such as a player's type or valuation, is privately known.

examples.en: The exercise used a game of incomplete information because each club knew only its own room valuation.
examples.zh: 练习用「不完全信息博弈」，因为各社团只知道自己对教室的估值。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which details were private in the game of incomplete information on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 老师问，练习表里的「不完全信息博弈」中哪些细节是私有的。

collocations: model a game of incomplete information
solve a game of incomplete information
specify types in a game of incomplete information

words.enDefinition: The study of decisions whose results depend on the choices of multiple participants.

examples.en: Our group used game theory to study how two clubs decided whether to share a room.
examples.zh: 我们组用「博弈论」研究两个社团如何决定是否共用一间教室。

examples.en: The tutor introduced game theory with an exercise about choosing times for a shared workshop.
examples.zh: 老师用一个选择共享工作坊时段的练习介绍了「博弈论」。

words.enDefinition: A branching representation of a game's move sequence, decision situations and possible endings.

examples.en: We drew a game tree to show how different offers led to different responses.
examples.zh: 我们画了一棵「博弈树」，展示不同提议怎样引出不同回应。

examples.en: The tutor added another branch to the game tree when the second club could suggest Tuesday.
examples.zh: 第二个社团可以提议周二时，老师在「博弈树」上又加了一个分支。

collocations: trace a path through a game tree
label payoffs on a game tree

words.zhGloss: 按市场价格计量的国内生产总值
words.enDefinition: Total gross value added at basic prices plus taxes on products less subsidies on products.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按市场价格计量的国内生产总值

examples.en: The workbook derives GDP at market prices by adding net product taxes to the value added total.
examples.zh: 练习册把产品税净额加到增加值总额上，得出「按市场价格计量的国内生产总值」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why GDP at market prices differs from the sum of industry value added.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么「按市场价格计量的国内生产总值」与各行业增加值之和不同。

words.zhGloss: 国内生产总值平减指数
words.enDefinition: a price index for domestically produced final output, commonly measured by comparing nominal GDP with real GDP
acceptedZhAnswers: 国内生产总值平减指数

examples.en: The worksheet uses the GDP deflator to separate output growth from changing prices in the example.
examples.zh: 练习用「国内生产总值平减指数」把示例中的产出增长与价格变动区分开。

examples.en: The GDP deflator covers the prices of final goods and services produced within the economy.
examples.zh: 「国内生产总值平减指数」涵盖本经济体生产的最终货物和服务的价格。

words.zhGloss: 国内生产总值增长分解
words.enDefinition: A breakdown of overall GDP growth into contributions from separately measured components.
acceptedZhAnswers: 国内生产总值增长分解

examples.en: The GDP growth decomposition shows how much the investment component added to quarterly growth.
examples.zh: 「国内生产总值增长分解」显示投资项目对季度增长贡献了多少。

examples.en: We read the GDP growth decomposition to distinguish the contributions of consumption and inventories.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「国内生产总值增长分解」，区分消费和存货各自的贡献。

words.enDefinition: An economy's GDP divided by its population.

examples.en: We divided GDP by the population to obtain GDP per capita for the toy economy.
examples.zh: 我们将 GDP 除以人口，得到模型经济体的「人均国内生产总值」。

examples.en: The tutor compared GDP per capita in two economies with very different population sizes.
examples.zh: 老师比较了两个人口规模差异很大的经济体的「人均国内生产总值」。

words.enDefinition: Good bought in larger quantities at higher own prices, other things equal

examples.en: The hypothetical Giffen good shows an income effect that outweighs the substitution effect.
examples.zh: 假想的「吉芬品」呈现出超过替代效应的收入效应。

examples.en: In the model, purchases of the Giffen good rise when its own price rises.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「吉芬品」自身的价格上涨时，其购买量也会上升。

collocations: demand curve for a Giffen good

words.enDefinition: a sequence of production tasks spread across economies that each add value to a final good or service

examples.en: The map traced the global value chain from fabric production to assembly and distribution in several countries.
examples.zh: 地图追踪了从布料生产、组装到多国配送的「全球价值链」。

examples.en: We discussed how disruption at one stage of a global value chain could affect deliveries elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「全球价值链」一个环节的中断如何可能影响其他地方的交付。

collocations: participate in a global value chain
analyse shocks in a global value chain

words.zhGloss: 按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入
words.enDefinition: gross national income per person expressed in common purchasing-power units using a purchasing power parity conversion
acceptedZhAnswers: 按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入

examples.en: The report used GNI per capita at PPP to compare average incomes across economies with different price levels.
examples.zh: 报告用「按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入」比较价格水平不同的经济体的平均收入。

examples.en: We checked whether the column measured GNI per capita at PPP or used a market exchange rate.
examples.zh: 我们核查该列衡量的是「按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入」，还是按市场汇率换算的数字。

collocations: compare GNI per capita at PPP
report GNI per capita at PPP
express GNI per capita at PPP

words.enDefinition: The steady-state capital level that maximizes lasting consumption per worker in a standard growth model.

examples.en: The chart marks the Golden Rule capital stock at the highest level of steady-state consumption.
examples.zh: 图表在稳态消费最高处标出「黄金律资本存量」。

examples.en: We used the worksheet to compare two examples with different levels of Golden Rule capital stock.
examples.zh: 我们用练习纸比较了两个具有不同「黄金律资本存量」水平的示例。

collocations: calculate the Golden Rule capital stock
determine the Golden Rule capital stock
below the Golden Rule capital stock

words.enDefinition: the BPM6 current account category for transactions in goods and services between residents and nonresidents

examples.en: The BPM6 goods and services account recorded visitor spending separately from sales of physical products in the sample.
examples.zh: 示例中的 BPM6「货物和服务账户」把访客消费与实体产品销售分开记录。

examples.en: We checked the goods and services account to see whether exports of services had offset weaker goods sales.
examples.zh: 我们核查「货物和服务账户」，看服务出口是否抵消了商品销售走弱的影响。

collocations: compile the goods and services account
read the goods and services account
analyse the balance on the goods and services account

words.enDefinition: Rate of price increase for goods in the price measure

examples.en: Our chart shows goods inflation easing as prices of household equipment stop rising sharply.
examples.zh: 我们的图显示，家用设备价格停止急涨后，「商品通胀」有所缓和。

examples.en: The class compared goods inflation with changes in the prices of selected services.
examples.zh: 全班把「商品通胀」和部分服务价格的变动进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: A situation in which a public intervention produces inefficient outcomes because of limitations such as information or incentives.

examples.en: The case illustrated government failure when the rule cost more to administer than the benefits it created.
examples.zh: 案例中的规定实施成本高于所产生的收益，体现了「政府失灵」。

examples.en: The class discussed government failure after finding that the policy missed the households it was intended to reach.
examples.zh: 发现政策未惠及目标家庭后，全班讨论了「政府失灵」。

collocations: explain a source of government failure
compare government failure with market failure

words.enDefinition: Public expenditure on goods and services used for individual or collective consumption, including government-provided services.

examples.en: The exercise counts public library services as part of government final consumption expenditure in the example accounts.
examples.zh: 练习将公共图书馆服务计入示例账户的「政府最终消费支出」。

examples.en: We compared government final consumption expenditure with spending on constructing a long-lived public building.
examples.zh: 我们把「政府最终消费支出」和修建长期使用的公共建筑的支出作了比较。

collocations: government final consumption expenditure on services
growth in government final consumption expenditure

words.enDefinition: a model relating trade between economies to their economic sizes and to costs or barriers such as distance

examples.en: The gravity model of trade predicted more exchange between large neighbouring economies than between similar distant economies.
examples.zh: 「贸易引力模型」预测，相邻的大型经济体之间的贸易多于类似但相距较远的经济体。

examples.en: We estimated a gravity model of trade after adding variables for distance and shared borders.
examples.zh: 我们先加入距离和接壤边界变量，再估计一个「贸易引力模型」。

collocations: estimate a gravity model of trade
apply the gravity model of trade
interpret coefficients in a gravity model of trade

words.enDefinition: A strategy that cooperates until a defection occurs and then permanently switches to the noncooperative action.

examples.en: The grim trigger strategy ended all future contributions after the other team first stopped contributing.
examples.zh: 另一队首次停止出资后，「严厉触发策略」会终止此后的所有出资。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a grim trigger strategy with a response lasting only one classroom round.
examples.zh: 老师把「严厉触发策略」与只持续一个课堂轮次的应对方式作了比较。

collocations: compare a grim trigger strategy with a temporary response

words.enDefinition: The total of gross fixed capital formation, changes in inventories, and net acquisitions of valuables.

examples.en: The table's gross capital formation figure includes both new machinery and the increase in inventories.
examples.zh: 表中的「资本形成总额」既包括新增机器，也包括存货增加额。

examples.en: We used gross capital formation to account for more than purchases of buildings and equipment.
examples.zh: 我们使用「资本形成总额」来涵盖建筑物和设备购置之外的项目。

collocations: gross capital formation as a share of GDP

words.enDefinition: An income-side measure of the value of domestic production in the national accounts.

examples.en: Gross domestic income is estimated from the incomes generated by production in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例根据生产产生的收入估计「国内总收入」。

examples.en: The instructor compared gross domestic income with the expenditure-side estimate for the same quarter.
examples.zh: 老师把「国内总收入」与同一季度从支出侧得出的估计作了比较。

words.enDefinition: gross national income divided by population, under the population and currency conventions used by the statistical source

examples.en: We compared gross national income per capita after confirming both columns used the same conversion method.
examples.zh: 确认两列数据使用相同换算方法后，我们比较了「人均国民总收入」。

examples.en: The class discussed why gross national income per capita could rise without every household receiving more income.
examples.zh: 同学们讨论了为何即使并非每户都增收，「人均国民总收入」也可能上升。

collocations: calculate gross national income per capita
compare gross national income per capita
report gross national income per capita

words.enDefinition: the surplus from production before depreciation for units not using mixed income as the balancing item, after employee compensation and applicable net production taxes

examples.en: The income table shows gross operating surplus before deducting the cost of fixed capital consumption.
examples.zh: 收入表显示扣除固定资本消耗之前的「总营业盈余」。

examples.en: The tutor calculated gross operating surplus for a fictional company using the production account.
examples.zh: 老师用生产账户计算一家虚构公司的「总营业盈余」。

words.enDefinition: The value of output less intermediate consumption, before deducting consumption of fixed capital.

examples.en: We calculated gross value added by subtracting purchased materials and services from the bakery's output.
examples.zh: 我们从面包店的产出中扣除外购材料和服务，计算「总增加值」。

examples.en: The gross value added of each industry appears in a separate row of the worksheet.
examples.zh: 各行业的「总增加值」分别列在练习表的不同行。

collocations: gross value added at basic prices

words.enDefinition: An underlying time trend allowed to vary by group in a model.

examples.en: The sensitivity exercise adds a group-specific trend to allow the two districts to evolve differently.
examples.zh: 敏感性练习加入「组别特定趋势」，让两个地区可有不同的发展趋势。

examples.en: We explained the extra assumptions needed when including a group-specific trend in this classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们解释了在课堂模型中加入「组别特定趋势」所需的额外假设。

words.zhGloss: 组别—时间平均处理效应
words.enDefinition: The average treatment effect for a specified treatment cohort in a particular calendar period.
acceptedZhAnswers: 组别—时间平均处理效应

examples.en: The group-time average treatment effect describes one cohort's outcomes in one year of the example.
examples.zh: 「组别—时间平均处理效应」描述示例中某个处理批次在指定一年的结果效应。

examples.en: We computed a group-time average treatment effect before combining estimates across the fictional school cohorts.
examples.zh: 我们先计算「组别—时间平均处理效应」，再合并不同虚构学校批次的估计。

collocations: estimate a group-time average treatment effect
display a group-time average treatment effect

words.enDefinition: A method of separating output growth into contributions associated with input growth and remaining productivity change.

examples.en: Growth accounting separates the effect of additional hours from changes in productivity in the example.
examples.zh: 示例用「增长核算」区分工时增加的影响与生产率变动。

examples.en: We used growth accounting to explain why output grew faster than labour input in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「增长核算」解释为什么产出增速超过劳动投入增速。

words.enDefinition: The tendency for economies starting at different income or productivity levels to move closer over time.

examples.en: The class used growth convergence to discuss whether poorer economies might narrow the income gap.
examples.zh: 全班用「经济增长趋同」讨论较贫穷经济体能否缩小收入差距。

examples.en: The two fictional economies illustrate growth convergence as their output per worker becomes more similar.
examples.zh: 随着每名劳动者产出越来越接近，两个虚构经济体体现了「经济增长趋同」。

words.enDefinition: Consumer price index compiled using shared methods for comparable European statistics

examples.en: We used the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices to compare inflation across two European countries in our assignment.
examples.zh: 作业中，我们用「调和消费者价格指数」比较了两个欧洲国家的通胀。

examples.en: The release shows changes in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices for several groups of goods and services.
examples.zh: 这份发布材料列出了几类商品和服务的「调和消费者价格指数」变动情况。

collocations: publish the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices
Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices weights
changes in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices

words.enDefinition: A limit on the quantity of a natural resource that may be taken during a period.

examples.en: The exercise set a harvest quota for the shared fishery to model a limit on total catches.
examples.zh: 练习为共享渔场设定「资源采收配额」，模拟对捕捞总量的限制。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the harvest quota with a system that limited how many people could enter.
examples.zh: 老师把「资源采收配额」与限制进入人数的制度作了比较。

collocations: compare a harvest quota with unrestricted access
model the effect of a harvest quota

words.enDefinition: Price growth measured across all categories covered by the selected index

examples.en: Higher energy prices lifted headline inflation in the exercise while other categories changed little.
examples.zh: 在习题中，能源价格上涨推高了「总体通胀」，而其他类别变化很小。

examples.en: We compared headline inflation across two reports based on different overall price indexes.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份采用不同总体价格指数的报告里的「总体通胀」。

words.enDefinition: a model linking trade patterns to differences in economies' relative factor endowments and goods' relative factor intensities

examples.en: The Heckscher-Ohlin model predicted that the capital-rich economy would export the goods produced with relatively more capital.
examples.zh: 「赫克歇尔俄林模型」预测资本丰富的经济体会出口相对耗用更多资本的商品。

examples.en: We identified both input ratios before applying the Heckscher-Ohlin model to the example economies.
examples.zh: 将「赫克歇尔俄林模型」用于示例经济体之前，我们先确定两种要素比率。

collocations: derive a result in the Heckscher-Ohlin model
test assumptions of the Heckscher-Ohlin model

words.enDefinition: a market concentration measure calculated by summing the squares of firms' market shares

examples.en: The class used the Herfindahl-Hirschman index to compare two markets with equally many firms but differently distributed sales.
examples.zh: 我们班用「赫芬达尔赫希曼指数」比较厂商数量相同、销售份额分布不同的两个市场。

examples.en: We calculated the Herfindahl-Hirschman index after converting each firm's share to the units specified in class.
examples.zh: 我们把各厂商份额转换成课堂规定的单位后，计算了「赫芬达尔赫希曼指数」。

words.enDefinition: Variation in the conditional variance of the regression disturbance across values of the regressors.

examples.en: The fan shape in the residual plot suggests possible heteroskedasticity in our classroom wage model.
examples.zh: 残差图呈扇形，提示课堂工资模型可能存在「异方差」。

examples.en: We discussed heteroskedasticity because the spread of wages rises at higher levels of experience in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，经验较高时工资的离散程度更大，因此我们讨论了「异方差」。

words.enDefinition: An estimate of coefficient uncertainty that allows for unequal error variances under suitable sampling conditions.

examples.en: We used a heteroskedasticity-robust standard error for the coefficient in the independent classroom observations.
examples.zh: 在课堂独立观测数据中，我们为该系数使用「异方差稳健标准误」。

examples.en: The heteroskedasticity-robust standard error changed even though the wage coefficient stayed the same in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中工资系数不变，但「异方差稳健标准误」发生了变化。

words.enDefinition: Quantities minimizing spending at given prices while reaching a target satisfaction level

examples.en: The worksheet derives Hicksian demand by holding satisfaction fixed and minimizing the shopping bill.
examples.zh: 习题保持满足感不变，并使购物支出最小化，从而推导「希克斯需求」。

examples.en: We find Hicksian demand by choosing the least expensive bundle that meets the target.
examples.zh: 我们选择达到目标且花费最少的组合，从而求得「希克斯需求」。

words.enDefinition: An action taken by one party that another party cannot directly observe or readily verify.

examples.en: The instructor described maintenance effort as a hidden action because the workshop owner could not observe it.
examples.zh: 讲师把维护投入视为「隐藏行动」，因为工场的所有者无法观察它。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked whether the reward would encourage more care when effort was a hidden action.
examples.zh: 练习表问，在投入属于「隐藏行动」时，奖励能否让人更认真。

collocations: an incentive problem involving hidden action

words.enDefinition: Relevant facts about a participant or product that one party knows but the other cannot readily observe.

examples.en: The model treated previous repairs as hidden information because only the bicycle seller knew about them.
examples.zh: 只有自行车卖家知道此前的维修，模型将其视作「隐藏信息」。

examples.en: We discussed hidden information before asking whether a credible inspection report could improve the transaction.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「隐藏信息」，再问可信的检验报告能否改善交易结果。

collocations: respond to hidden information with screening

words.enDefinition: A strategy whose prescribed actions can vary with previous observed events in a game.

examples.en: The class examined a history-dependent strategy that changed after one club stopped contributing to the activity.
examples.zh: 同学们考察了一种「依赖历史的策略」，一个社团不再为活动出资后，该策略随之变化。

examples.en: We wrote a history-dependent strategy for the shared equipment game before playing three practice rounds.
examples.zh: 我们先给共享设备博弈写出一种「依赖历史的策略」，再玩三轮练习。

collocations: use a history-dependent strategy in a repeated game

words.enDefinition: temporary entry to serve a profitable portion of a market, followed by exit with little unrecoverable cost in the contestable-market model

examples.en: The lecture used hit-and-run entry to explain why the model's incumbents faced pressure despite having few active competitors.
examples.zh: 课堂用「短期进入后退出」解释，为什么即使活跃竞争者很少，模型中的既有厂商也面临压力。

examples.en: We compared hit-and-run entry with entering a market that required expensive installations with no resale value.
examples.zh: 我们将「短期进入后退出」与进入一个须配备昂贵且没有转售价值的设施的市场作了比较。

collocations: explain the threat of hit-and-run entry

words.enDefinition: To interpret or evaluate a model change without changing the values of the other variables.

examples.en: We hold other variables constant when interpreting the fitted wage change associated with one more year of schooling.
examples.zh: 我们解释受教育年限多一年所对应的工资拟合变化时，「保持其他变量不变」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks us to hold other variables constant while changing the value of attendance.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们改变出勤率的取值时，「保持其他变量不变」。

collocations: hold other variables constant in a comparison
hold other variables constant by construction
interpret a coefficient holding other variables constant

words.enDefinition: A bargaining problem where dependence after a specific sunk investment weakens the investing party's position.

examples.en: The case illustrated a hold-up problem after one group built equipment suitable for only one shared venue.
examples.zh: 一个小组建造了只能用于某个共享场地的设备后，案例展示了由此出现的「套牢问题」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how an earlier agreement would affect the hold-up problem in the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，较早达成协议会怎样影响例题中的「套牢问题」。

collocations: discuss how a contract addresses a hold-up problem

words.enDefinition: a product buyers treat as equivalent regardless of which seller provides it in the market model

examples.en: The model assumed a homogeneous product, so customers regarded flour from the different farms as interchangeable.
examples.zh: 模型假定面粉为「同质产品」，因此顾客认为不同农场的面粉可以互相替代。

examples.en: We tested whether the market for a homogeneous product still allowed differences in delivery times in the case.
examples.zh: 我们检验案例中「同质产品」市场是否仍允许交付时间有差异。

collocations: compete in a market with a homogeneous product

words.enDefinition: A constant conditional variance of the regression disturbance across values of the regressors.

examples.en: The first classroom simulation assumes homoskedasticity by using the same error variance at every schooling level.
examples.zh: 第一次课堂模拟采用「同方差」假设，在各受教育水平上使用相同的误差方差。

examples.en: We compared the homoskedasticity assumption with a scenario where errors spread out as wages increase.
examples.zh: 我们把「同方差」假设与工资越高、误差越分散的情形作了比较。

words.enDefinition: differences in attributes for which buyers may prefer different products at the same price

examples.en: The horizontal product differentiation example offered two equal-priced flavours, and neither appealed to every customer.
examples.zh: 「横向产品差异化」示例提供两种同价口味，没有一种能吸引所有顾客。

examples.en: Our tutor explained horizontal product differentiation using preference for store location rather than a single quality ranking.
examples.zh: 导师用不同顾客对店址的偏好说明「横向产品差异化」，没有用统一的质量排名。

collocations: compare horizontal product differentiation with quality differences

words.enDefinition: adding the quantities represented by different demand or supply curves at each common price

examples.en: We used horizontal summation to combine three shoppers' choices of apples at every price.
examples.zh: 我们用「横向加总」汇总了三名顾客在各个价格下选择购买的苹果数量。

examples.en: With horizontal summation, our class added the two bakeries' quantities without adding their prices.
examples.zh: 我们班用「横向加总」把两家面包店的供给量相加，没有把价格相加。

words.enDefinition: Income available to households for consumption or saving after current taxes and net current transfers are accounted for.

examples.en: The table reports household disposable income after subtracting the current taxes shown in the example.
examples.zh: 示例表在扣除列出的当期税款后，报告「住户可支配收入」。

examples.en: We compared household disposable income with household spending in the fictional economy's accounts.
examples.zh: 我们把虚构经济体账户里的「住户可支配收入」与住户支出作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Spending by resident households on goods and services used to meet their needs and wants.

examples.en: The worksheet puts the household's grocery purchase under household final consumption expenditure for the quarter.
examples.zh: 练习纸将该住户买食品的花费归入本季度的「住户最终消费支出」。

examples.en: The class compared household final consumption expenditure on services with the figure for durable goods.
examples.zh: 全班比较了服务类「住户最终消费支出」与耐用品的相应数据。

collocations: household final consumption expenditure by category
growth in household final consumption expenditure

words.enDefinition: Household saving expressed as a share of household disposable income, using the account's stated adjustments.

examples.en: The household saving ratio rises when families save a larger share of the income they can spend.
examples.zh: 家庭从可支配收入中存下的比例提高时，「住户储蓄率」随之上升。

examples.en: We checked how the household saving ratio was calculated before comparing the two fictional economies.
examples.zh: 比较两个虚构经济体前，我们先查阅「住户储蓄率」的计算口径。

words.enDefinition: Survey asking individuals or households about employment and other personal characteristics

examples.en: The US household survey counts an employed person once even if they hold two jobs.
examples.zh: 美国的「住户调查」中，即使同一个人有两份工作，也只计为一名就业者。

examples.en: We checked the household survey for information about people actively looking for work.
examples.zh: 我们在「住户调查」中查找积极求职者的相关数据。

words.enDefinition: The knowledge, skills, and other capabilities people acquire that can contribute to production.

examples.en: The lecture uses training to illustrate how workers can develop human capital over time.
examples.zh: 讲座用培训说明劳动者如何逐步提高「人力资本」。

examples.en: Our model includes human capital to explain part of the difference in output per worker.
examples.zh: 模型纳入「人力资本」，以解释每名劳动者产出差异的一部分。

words.enDefinition: a UNDP composite index combining standardised measures of health, education and income through a geometric mean

examples.en: The Human Development Index differed across two economies that reported comparable average incomes in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例里，两个报告平均收入相近的经济体具有不同的「人类发展指数」。

examples.en: We checked which education indicators entered the Human Development Index before discussing why one country's score changed.
examples.zh: 讨论某国得分为何变化之前，我们核查「人类发展指数」纳入哪些教育指标。

words.enDefinition: Extremely rapid and sustained increases in the general level of prices

examples.en: The historical case on hyperinflation shows how quickly the purchasing power of cash fell.
examples.zh: 关于「恶性通胀」的历史案例展示了现金购买力下降得有多快。

examples.en: The tutor used a monthly price chart to illustrate the scale of hyperinflation.
examples.zh: 老师用一张月度价格图来说明「恶性通胀」的幅度。

words.enDefinition: A condition that lets researchers recover the effect of interest from the available comparisons or data.

examples.en: The identifying assumption says the two schools would otherwise have followed the same average trend.
examples.zh: 这项「识别假设」认为，在没有项目的情况下，两所学校的平均趋势相同。

examples.en: We wrote down the identifying assumption before explaining what the estimated difference might represent.
examples.zh: 我们先写明「识别假设」，再解释估计差异可能代表什么。

words.enDefinition: Time after policy implementation before its economic effects become evident

examples.en: We modeled an impact lag between a change in rates and changes in household spending.
examples.zh: 我们模拟了利率变动与家庭支出变化之间的「作用时滞」。

examples.en: The lecture uses the impact lag to explain why inflation may respond gradually.
examples.zh: 课堂用「作用时滞」解释了为什么通胀可能逐步作出反应。

words.enDefinition: A situation in which some units do not follow their assigned treatment status.

examples.en: Imperfect compliance occurs when some students assigned an offer choose not to attend the simulated tutoring.
examples.zh: 在模拟里，有些获邀学生选择不参加辅导，就出现了「不完全依从」。

examples.en: The exercise asks how imperfect compliance changes the interpretation of the effect of an offer.
examples.zh: 练习问「不完全依从」如何改变对邀请效应的解读。

words.enDefinition: Lack of reliable information needed to make a fully informed economic decision.

examples.en: The case studied imperfect information when neither seller nor buyer knew how long the equipment would last.
examples.zh: 买卖双方都不知道设备还能用多久，案例用这一情形讨论了「不完全信息」。

examples.en: Our group discussed how imperfect information affected the range of prices considered in the example.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了「不完全信息」怎样影响例题所考虑的价格范围。

words.enDefinition: A game in which at least one player cannot observe the full history at a decision point.

examples.en: The classroom exercise became an imperfect-information game when the second team could not see the first choice.
examples.zh: 第二队看不到第一队的选择后，课堂练习变成了「不完美信息博弈」。

examples.en: We labelled the indistinguishable situations before analysing the imperfect-information game on the board.
examples.zh: 分析黑板上的「不完美信息博弈」之前，我们标出了无法区分的几种情形。

collocations: specify information sets in an imperfect-information game

words.enDefinition: Delay between deciding on a policy and putting it into effect

examples.en: The project example illustrates an implementation lag between approval and actual construction spending.
examples.zh: 该项目示例说明了批准与实际发生建设支出之间的「实施时滞」。

examples.en: Our chart places the implementation lag after the government chooses a fiscal measure.
examples.zh: 我们的图把「实施时滞」放在政府选定财政措施之后。

words.enDefinition: an opportunity cost of using resources already owned by the firm without directly paying for them

examples.en: The owner gave up rental income by using her building, so the model included an implicit cost.
examples.zh: 业主自己使用楼宇而放弃了租金收入，所以模型计入一项「隐性成本」。

examples.en: We estimated the implicit cost of the organizer's time before comparing the project's alternative uses of labour.
examples.zh: 比较这个项目的其他用工方案前，我们估算了组织者时间的「隐性成本」。

collocations: compare an implicit cost with a cash expense

words.enDefinition: a graph of the quantity demanded from abroad at alternative prices, often derived from domestic demand minus domestic supply

examples.en: The import demand curve reached zero at the price where domestic supply met domestic demand.
examples.zh: 在国内供给等于国内需求的价格处，「进口需求曲线」的进口量为零。

examples.en: We drew the import demand curve from the differences between domestic consumption and production at each price.
examples.zh: 我们用各价格下国内消费与生产的差额，绘出「进口需求曲线」。

collocations: read a quantity from the import demand curve

words.enDefinition: the share of domestic use or consumption of a product supplied by imports, under the stated measurement convention

examples.en: We calculated import penetration using domestic consumption rather than total output as the denominator in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们用国内消费量作分母来计算「进口渗透率」。

examples.en: The industry report showed import penetration rising while the total amount purchased by local firms also grew.
examples.zh: 行业报告显示，当地厂商购买总量增长的同时，「进口渗透率」也在上升。

collocations: explain a rise in import penetration

words.enDefinition: a limit on the quantity or value of a good allowed to enter a market in a period

examples.en: The import quota limited the number of bicycles the model economy could buy from overseas that year.
examples.zh: 「进口配额」限制了模型经济体当年可从国外采购的自行车数量。

examples.en: We compared the import quota with a tariff that achieved the same trade quantity in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们将「进口配额」与练习里造成相同贸易量的关税作了比较。

collocations: measure the effect of an import quota
compare an import quota with a tariff

words.enDefinition: the rate charged on goods admitted within the lower-rate quantity under a tariff-rate quota

examples.en: The in-quota tariff applied to the imports that occupied part of the lower-rate allocation in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，占用低税率额度的进口适用「配额内关税」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the in-quota tariff with the higher rate shown for imports beyond the specified volume.
examples.zh: 导师将「配额内关税」与进口超过规定数量时的更高税率作了比较。

collocations: compare the in-quota tariff with the out-of-quota tariff

words.enDefinition: A property of rules or contracts under which participants find the desired actions to be in their own interest.

examples.en: Our worksheet tested incentive compatibility by asking which option each type of participant would actually choose.
examples.zh: 练习表通过询问各类型参加者实际会选择什么选项，检验「激励相容性」。

examples.en: The tutor discussed incentive compatibility after changing the reward attached to one of the available options.
examples.zh: 老师调整了其中一个可选项的奖励后，讨论了「激励相容性」。

words.enDefinition: A contract linking a party's rewards to outcomes or measures intended to encourage desired behaviour.

examples.en: The simulated workshop used an incentive contract linking part of the payment to verified work quality.
examples.zh: 模拟工场用「激励合同」将部分报酬与经核实的工作质量挂钩。

examples.en: The class discussed whether the incentive contract rewarded outcomes that the contractor could actually influence.
examples.zh: 全班讨论这份「激励合同」所奖励的成果是否确实在承包方的影响范围内。

words.enDefinition: the receipt of a targeted benefit by someone outside the intended eligible group

examples.en: The classroom example counted an inclusion error when a payment went to an ineligible household in the sample.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，补助付给样本中不符合资格的家庭时，记作一次「错纳误差」。

examples.en: We reported the inclusion error rate using all recipients as the denominator in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较以所有领取者为分母，我们据此报告「错纳误差」的发生率。

collocations: estimate the rate of inclusion error
distinguish inclusion error from exclusion error

words.enDefinition: A method of measuring GDP by adding incomes generated in production and relevant net taxes on production and imports.

examples.en: The income approach adds workers' compensation and the operating surplus generated in the sample economy.
examples.zh: 「收入法」加总示例经济体生产所产生的雇员报酬和营业盈余。

examples.en: We compared the totals from the income approach with the figures from the expenditure approach.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「收入法」得出的总量和支出法的数据。

collocations: estimate GDP using the income approach

words.enDefinition: Path of optimal consumption bundles as income changes while prices stay fixed

examples.en: We traced an income-consumption curve by joining the best bundles at three income levels.
examples.zh: 我们连接三个收入水平下的最优组合，画出了「收入消费曲线」。

examples.en: Each point on the income-consumption curve gives the chosen quantities of both goods.
examples.zh: 「收入消费曲线」上的每个点都给出两种商品各自的选择数量。

words.enDefinition: Demand change due to a price shift's effect on purchasing power

examples.en: We isolated the income effect after a lower bus fare increased the household's purchasing power.
examples.zh: 公交票价下降提升了这个家庭的购买力，我们把其中的「收入效应」单独分析。

examples.en: A positive income effect for this good reinforced the shift caused by relative prices.
examples.zh: 对这种商品而言，正向的「收入效应」加强了相对价格变化带来的影响。

collocations: income effect of a price change

words.enDefinition: Ratio of the percentage change in purchases to that in income

examples.en: The income elasticity of demand was negative for this item in our fictional household survey.
examples.zh: 在我们虚构的家庭调查中，该商品的「需求收入弹性」为负。

examples.en: The instructor held prices fixed to find the income elasticity of demand for weekend train travel.
examples.zh: 老师将价格保持不变，求出了周末火车出行的「需求收入弹性」。

collocations: calculate the income elasticity of demand

words.enDefinition: a trade outcome in which an economy shifts resources toward selected activities but still produces multiple goods

examples.en: Our example showed incomplete specialisation because both goods remained profitable at the country's new relative price.
examples.zh: 在该国新的相对价格下，两种商品仍有利可图，所以示例出现了「不完全专业化分工」。

examples.en: We used a curved production frontier to show when incomplete specialisation could persist after trade opened.
examples.zh: 我们用弯曲的生产可能性边界说明，开放贸易后何时仍会存在「不完全专业化分工」。

words.enDefinition: A case in which less than the full amount of a tax change reaches buyers through price changes.

examples.en: The worksheet showed incomplete tax pass-through because the buyer price rose by less than the new tax.
examples.zh: 买方价格的涨幅小于新税额，练习表据此展示了「税收不完全转嫁」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared incomplete tax pass-through with a case where the buyer's price rose by the entire tax.
examples.zh: 老师把「税收不完全转嫁」与买方价格涨幅等于全部税额的例题作了比较。

collocations: explain incomplete tax pass-through with a graph

words.enDefinition: Rightward curve shift reflecting more purchases at each price shown

examples.en: The new club created an increase in demand for dance shoes at each possible price.
examples.zh: 新社团成立使得每个可能价格下的舞鞋「需求增加」。

examples.en: We drew an increase in demand by placing the curve farther from the vertical axis.
examples.zh: 我们把曲线画在离纵轴更远的位置，表示「需求增加」。

words.enDefinition: Rightward curve shift reflecting more goods offered at each price shown

examples.en: The model shows an increase in supply for strawberries after more farms enter the market.
examples.zh: 模型显示，更多农场进入市场后，草莓的「供给增加」。

examples.en: An increase in supply moves the curve to the right of its initial position.
examples.zh: 「供给增加」会使曲线向初始位置的右侧移动。

words.enDefinition: a case where output grows by a greater proportion than the common proportional increase in all inputs

examples.en: The example showed increasing returns to scale when doubling both inputs more than doubled output.
examples.zh: 示例中把两种投入都加倍，成品数却增至两倍以上，表现为「规模报酬递增」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why increasing returns to scale could hold while one input's marginal product was diminishing.
examples.zh: 导师问，一种投入要素的边际产量在递减时，为什么仍可能出现「规模报酬递增」。

collocations: distinguish increasing returns to scale from diminishing marginal returns

words.enDefinition: Known individual valuations that are statistically independent across bidders in an auction model.

examples.en: The classroom model assumed independent private values and gave each participant a separate randomly chosen number.
examples.zh: 课堂模型假定「独立私有价值」，给每位参与者分别指定一个随机数。

examples.en: We asked how the exercise would change if the assumption of independent private values no longer held.
examples.zh: 我们问，如果「独立私有价值」的假设不再成立，练习结果会怎样变化。

collocations: compare auctions under independent private values

words.enDefinition: Period whose index value serves as the reference for all readings

examples.en: We checked the index reference period before comparing the reported index levels across two tables.
examples.zh: 将两张表里列出的指数水平作比较前，我们先核对了「指数基准期」。

examples.en: The notes identify the index reference period as the year whose index value is one hundred.
examples.zh: 说明指出，「指数基准期」就是价格指数设定为一百的那一年。

words.enDefinition: Share assigned to a category when calculating an overall index

examples.en: Rent has a larger index weight than fruit in the classroom's example price basket.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例的物价篮子里，房租的「指数权重」大于水果。

examples.en: We used the index weight and price movement to estimate the category's overall contribution.
examples.zh: 我们用「指数权重」和价格变动估算了该类别对总体变动的贡献。

words.enDefinition: equality of a player's expected payoffs for options assigned positive probability in a mixed equilibrium

examples.en: The tutor wrote an indifference condition to make both options in the mixture equally attractive.
examples.zh: 老师写下一个「无差异条件」，使混合策略里的两个选项同样有吸引力。

examples.en: We used the indifference condition before checking whether a third option would give a higher payoff.
examples.zh: 在检查第三个选项能否给出更高收益之前，我们先用了「无差异条件」。

collocations: check the indifference condition for two strategies

words.enDefinition: Graph of bundles the consumer regards as equally desirable overall

examples.en: Both baskets are on the same indifference curve, so the shopper likes them equally.
examples.zh: 两个购物篮位于同一条「无差异曲线」上，因此购物者对它们的喜好程度相同。

examples.en: The class drew an indifference curve for combinations of different kinds of fruit.
examples.zh: 全班为不同水果搭配画出了一条「无差异曲线」。

words.enDefinition: Set of equal satisfaction curves representing one consumer's overall preference ranking

examples.en: We drew an indifference map with three curves for combinations of tea and biscuits.
examples.zh: 我们画了一幅有三条曲线的「无差异曲线图」，表示茶和饼干的不同组合。

examples.en: The indifference map lets us compare curve levels instead of reading every preference ranking separately.
examples.zh: 借助「无差异曲线图」可以比较各条曲线的层级，省去逐项阅读偏好排序。

words.enDefinition: Highest attainable satisfaction expressed as a function of prices and income

examples.en: We plugged prices and income into the indirect utility function to find the best attainable score.
examples.zh: 我们把价格和收入代入「间接效用函数」，求出了可达到的最高效用分值。

examples.en: The indirect utility function fell after the transport fare rose and income stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 交通票价上涨而收入保持不变后，「间接效用函数」值下降了。

collocations: properties of an indirect utility function

words.enDefinition: Graph of how much one buyer would buy at each price

examples.en: I drew an individual demand curve using only Maya's answers to the coffee price survey.
examples.zh: 我只用了玛雅对咖啡价格调查的回答来绘制「个人需求曲线」。

examples.en: The individual demand curve for concert tickets shows what one student would buy at each price.
examples.zh: 这条音乐会门票的「个人需求曲线」反映了一名学生在每个价格下愿意买多少张。

words.enDefinition: Graph of how much one seller would offer at each price

examples.en: The individual supply curve shows how many loaves a single bakery offers at different prices.
examples.zh: 「个体供给曲线」反映一家面包店在不同价格下愿意出售多少条面包。

examples.en: We drew an individual supply curve for one fruit stall before adding the other sellers.
examples.zh: 在加入其他卖家之前，我们先为一个水果摊画了「个体供给曲线」。

collocations: individual supply curve for a firm
slope of an individual supply curve

words.enDefinition: The difference between a unit's potential outcomes under two treatment conditions.

examples.en: The individual treatment effect in the simulation compares two possible scores for the same student.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，「个体处理效应」比较同一名学生的两个可能分数。

examples.en: Only one potential outcome is observed, so the student's individual treatment effect remains unknown in practice.
examples.zh: 实际只能观测一个潜在结果，因此该学生的「个体处理效应」仍然未知。

words.enDefinition: Valuations assigned through an experiment's payoff rules so participants face known incentives in the model.

examples.en: The tutor assigned induced values by specifying how many points each item was worth to its holder.
examples.zh: 老师通过规定各物品对持有者值多少分，分配了「诱导价值」。

examples.en: We used induced values to know what each participant stood to gain in the practice auction.
examples.zh: 我们用「诱导价值」了解各参与者在练习拍卖中可能获得多少收益。

collocations: use induced values in an experiment
compare choices under different induced values

words.enDefinition: An index tracking changes in the volume of production in the industries covered by the measure.

examples.en: The industrial production index falls when the three industries covered produce less in the fictional economy.
examples.zh: 虚构经济体纳入统计的三个行业减产时，「工业生产指数」下降。

examples.en: We read the base information before comparing changes in the industrial production index across quarters.
examples.zh: 我们先看基期说明，再比较各季度「工业生产指数」的变动。

collocations: change in the industrial production index

words.enDefinition: the extent to which activity in an industry is accounted for by a relatively small number of firms

examples.en: The industry concentration measure rose after two of the larger firms came under the same ownership.
examples.zh: 两家较大的厂商归于同一所有者后，「行业集中度」指标上升了。

examples.en: We checked how the defined market affected the estimate of industry concentration in the class exercise.
examples.zh: 我们检查课堂练习中市场的定义如何影响「行业集中度」的估计。

collocations: report a change in industry concentration

words.enDefinition: Demand for which purchases change proportionally less than the own price

examples.en: The model shows inelastic demand when purchases fall proportionally less than the price rises.
examples.zh: 当购买量降幅小于价格涨幅时，模型所示的是「缺乏弹性的需求」。

examples.en: Our case shows inelastic demand for bus rides over a short period with few alternatives.
examples.zh: 案例显示，短期内替代选项较少时，公交出行的需求属于「缺乏弹性的需求」。

words.enDefinition: Supply for which the amount offered changes proportionally less than price

examples.en: The model assumes inelastic supply for concert seating during the week before the show.
examples.zh: 该模型假设演出前一周音乐会座位的供给属于「缺乏弹性的供给」。

examples.en: We illustrated inelastic supply with a small increase in stock despite a sizable price rise.
examples.zh: 我们用价格大涨、库存供应量却略增的情况来说明「缺乏弹性的供给」。

words.zhGloss: 不平等调整后的人类发展指数
words.enDefinition: a UNDP measure discounting each human development dimension to account for inequality within the population
acceptedZhAnswers: 不平等调整后的人类发展指数

examples.en: We compared the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index with the unadjusted measure to see the effect of uneven outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们把「不平等调整后的人类发展指数」与未调整指标比较，了解结果分布不均的影响。

examples.en: The lesson used the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index to discuss unequal health and education outcomes.
examples.zh: 课程用「不平等调整后的人类发展指数」讨论健康和教育结果的不平等。

collocations: report the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index
compare Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index values
calculate the loss implied by the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index

words.enDefinition: Product whose demand decreases as buyers' income rises, prices held fixed

examples.en: In our model, instant noodles are an inferior good because higher income reduces their demand.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，方便面是「低档品」，因为收入提高会使其需求下降。

examples.en: The term inferior good describes a pattern of buying rather than the item's quality.
examples.zh: 「低档品」描述的是一种购买规律，商品质量另有衡量标准。

words.enDefinition: A model in which the same stage game is played over an unbounded sequence of periods.

examples.en: The worksheet introduced an infinitely repeated game without naming a final round for the shared project.
examples.zh: 练习表引入了「无限重复博弈」，没有给共同项目指定最后一轮。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed how valuing future meetings affected cooperation in the infinitely repeated game.
examples.zh: 老师讨论了对未来见面的重视程度怎样影响「无限重复博弈」中的合作。

collocations: model cooperation in an infinitely repeated game
calculate payoffs in an infinitely repeated game

words.enDefinition: Amount a component adds to or subtracts from overall price growth

examples.en: The report gives the inflation contribution of each category in percentage points.
examples.zh: 这份报告用百分点表示各类别的「通胀贡献」。

examples.en: We found a negative inflation contribution from fuel even though the overall index rose.
examples.zh: 虽然总体指数上涨，但燃油的「通胀贡献」为负。

words.enDefinition: Difference between inflation rates across economies, regions, or comparable groups

examples.en: We calculated the inflation differential between two regions using the same twelve-month comparison.
examples.zh: 我们采用相同的十二个月比较区间，计算两个地区的「通胀率之差」。

examples.en: The notes ask whether the inflation differential narrowed after energy prices stabilized in both regions.
examples.zh: 讲义问，在两地能源价格企稳后，「通胀率之差」是否缩小。

words.enDefinition: Beliefs about the likely rate of price increases over future periods

examples.en: The report compares inflation expectations among households and professional forecasters using the same time horizon.
examples.zh: 报告用同一个时间范围比较家庭和专业预测人士的「通胀预期」。

examples.en: The class discussed how inflation expectations can influence decisions about wages and prices today.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了「通胀预期」会怎样影响当前的工资和定价决策。

words.enDefinition: Adjusting amounts periodically in line with a specified measure of prices

examples.en: The model illustrates inflation indexation by linking payments to changes in a consumer index.
examples.zh: 模型把支付金额与消费价格指数的变化挂钩，说明「通胀指数化」。

examples.en: Our example compares fixed payments with another series that uses inflation indexation.
examples.zh: 这个例子将固定支付金额与采用「通胀指数化」的另一组金额作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which changes in inflation continue across periods after a disturbance

examples.en: The study found inflation persistence because inflation stayed elevated after the temporary shock faded.
examples.zh: 研究发现，尽管短期冲击消散，通胀仍居高不下，体现了「通胀持续性」。

examples.en: We compared inflation persistence in two model economies with different wage-setting arrangements.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两种工资设定方式不同的模型经济体的「通胀持续性」。

words.enDefinition: Percentage change in a broad measure of prices over a period

examples.en: We calculated the inflation rate from the change in the index over twelve months.
examples.zh: 我们根据十二个月内指数的变化计算了「通胀率」。

examples.en: A lower positive inflation rate still means the index rose during the comparison period.
examples.zh: 「通胀率」虽然下降但仍为正，说明指数在对比期间依旧上涨。

words.enDefinition: Difference between realized inflation and the rate previously expected for that period

examples.en: The plot shows a positive inflation surprise when observed inflation exceeds the previous forecast.
examples.zh: 实际通胀高于先前预测时，图上显示为正向「通胀意外」。

examples.en: We measured the inflation surprise by comparing the reading with the survey estimate from June.
examples.zh: 我们把实际读数与六月调查估值作比较，衡量了「通胀意外」。

words.enDefinition: Specified inflation rate or range a central bank seeks over time

examples.en: We compared the inflation target with the expected inflation rate over the same horizon.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「通胀目标」和相同时段内的预期通胀率。

examples.en: The case study examines how policymakers explain a temporary deviation from the inflation target.
examples.zh: 案例研究了政策制定者如何解释暂时偏离「通胀目标」。

words.enDefinition: Framework using a stated inflation objective to guide and explain monetary policy

examples.en: The course used inflation targeting to discuss why some central banks publish inflation forecasts.
examples.zh: 课堂以「通胀目标制」为例，讨论一些央行为什么公布通胀预测。

examples.en: Our model illustrates inflation targeting when the central bank responds to forecasts of above-target inflation.
examples.zh: 当央行对高于目标的通胀预测作出反应时，我们的模型展示了「通胀目标制」。

words.enDefinition: Model outcome where reducing inflation can temporarily require more unemployment

examples.en: Our model illustrates an inflation-unemployment trade-off in the short run when price expectations remain fixed.
examples.zh: 我们的模型说明了预期物价不变时短期内「通胀与失业的权衡」。

examples.en: The lecture asks how shifting expectations change the apparent inflation-unemployment trade-off over time.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了预期变化如何改变不同时间观察到的「通胀与失业的权衡」。

words.enDefinition: An observation whose removal or alteration substantially changes the fitted model or an estimate of interest.

examples.en: One influential observation changes the fitted wage relationship substantially when removed from the classroom dataset.
examples.zh: 从课堂数据集中移除某个「高影响观测值」，拟合的工资关系就会明显变化。

examples.en: We investigated the influential observation to check the recorded units before repeating the regression.
examples.zh: 我们检查这个「高影响观测值」的记录单位，再重新做回归。

words.enDefinition: employment without specified formal arrangements or protections, as defined by the applicable labour statistics standard

examples.en: The report measured informal employment after documenting which categories were covered by its household survey.
examples.zh: 报告说明住户调查涵盖哪些类别后，对「非正规就业」作了统计。

examples.en: We checked how informal employment was defined before comparing the two estimates in the dataset.
examples.zh: 比较数据集内的两个估计值之前，我们核查了「非正规就业」的定义。

collocations: estimate the share of informal employment

words.enDefinition: Providing relevant details to another party so that its market decisions are better informed.

examples.en: The model used information disclosure to show buyers the recorded condition of each secondhand bicycle.
examples.zh: 模型通过「信息披露」向买家展示每辆二手自行车的已记录车况。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether information disclosure changed both the price and the number of trades.
examples.zh: 老师问，「信息披露」是否同时改变了价格和交易数量。

collocations: assess the effect of information disclosure

words.enDefinition: A collection of decision points a player cannot distinguish when choosing an action.

examples.en: The tutor joined the two decision points to indicate a single information set for that player.
examples.zh: 老师把两个决策点连起来，表示对该参与者而言它们属于同一个「信息集」。

examples.en: Our diagram used an information set because the second club did not know which move had occurred.
examples.zh: 因为第二个社团不知道先前发生了哪项行动，我们在图中用了一个「信息集」。

collocations: assign beliefs to an information set

words.enDefinition: Balanced market outcome before a change in the conditions being studied

examples.en: We marked the initial equilibrium before shifting the curves in the bus pass example.
examples.zh: 在公交车通票的例子中，我们先标出了「初始均衡」，再移动曲线。

examples.en: Use the initial equilibrium as a reference point when discussing the effect of new sellers.
examples.zh: 讨论新卖家的影响时，可以用「初始均衡」作参照。

words.enDefinition: The root of a game tree, representing the situation before any move has been made.

examples.en: We marked the initial node before drawing the first two options in the classroom game.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「博弈起始节点」，再把课堂博弈最初的两个选项画出来。

examples.en: The worksheet attached two arrows to the initial node to represent the first club's choices.
examples.zh: 练习表从「博弈起始节点」引出两条箭头，表示第一个社团的选择。

collocations: draw branches from the initial node

words.enDefinition: The first distribution of tradable emissions allowances before participants start trading them.

examples.en: The initial permit allocation gave two simulated factories different allowances before any permits changed hands.
examples.zh: 在任何配额交易发生前，「排放配额初始分配」给两家模拟工厂发放了不同数量的配额。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the initial permit allocation with the holdings after the first trading round.
examples.zh: 老师对比了「排放配额初始分配」和第一轮交易结束后的持有量。

words.enDefinition: a specified combination of quantities of the inputs available to a producer

examples.en: The first input bundle required fewer work hours but more machine hours than the alternative bundle.
examples.zh: 第一种「投入组合」需要较少人工工时，却比另一组合需要更多机器工时。

examples.en: We chose the input bundle that met the required output at the lowest cost in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们选择以最低成本达到指定产量的「投入组合」。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which different inputs can replace each other while producing the same output

examples.en: The model compared input substitutability between firms using flexible tools and firms using a fixed assembly process.
examples.zh: 模型对比采用灵活工具的厂商与采用固定装配流程的厂商的「投入要素的可替代性」。

examples.en: We discussed whether input substitutability would allow a producer to adjust after either input became more expensive.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了任一投入要素价格上涨后，「投入要素的可替代性」能否让生产者作出调整。

collocations: compare the degree of input substitutability

words.enDefinition: A grouping of institutional units with similar functions and economic behaviour in the national accounts.

examples.en: The tutor assigned households to one institutional sector and financial companies to another in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，老师将住户归入一个「机构部门」，将金融公司归入另一个部门。

examples.en: Our practice table reports a separate saving figure for each institutional sector in the sample economy.
examples.zh: 练习表分别报告示例经济体各「机构部门」的储蓄数据。

words.enDefinition: The requirement that an instrument is independent of, or uncorrelated with, relevant unobserved outcome determinants under the model.

examples.en: Our instrument exogeneity discussion asks whether the lottery result is related to unmeasured student abilities.
examples.zh: 关于「工具变量外生性」的讨论要求判断抽签结果是否与未测量的学生能力有关。

examples.en: We stated instrument exogeneity separately from the assumption about the instrument's link to participation.
examples.zh: 我们把「工具变量外生性」和工具变量与参与之间关联的假设分别写明。

words.enDefinition: for a binary instrument, the assumption that moving from one instrument value to the other can only change treatment in a common direction

examples.en: Instrument monotonicity rules out students who would attend only when they did not receive an offer.
examples.zh: 「工具变量单调性」排除了只有没收到邀请才参加的学生。

examples.en: We discussed instrument monotonicity when interpreting which group the estimated effect would describe in the simulation.
examples.zh: 解释估计效应适用于模拟中哪一组时，我们讨论了「工具变量单调性」。

words.enDefinition: The requirement that an instrument provides variation in the endogenous regressor it is used for.

examples.en: Instrument relevance requires that the simulated offer changes the likelihood of taking part in tutoring.
examples.zh: 「工具变量相关性」要求模拟邀请改变参加辅导的可能性。

examples.en: We discussed instrument relevance after comparing attendance rates across the two randomized offer groups.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个随机邀请组的出席率之后，讨论了「工具变量相关性」。

words.enDefinition: A variable used to isolate exogenous variation in an endogenous regressor under specified validity conditions.

examples.en: The class considered a simulated offer as an instrumental variable for actual participation in tutoring.
examples.zh: 全班考虑用模拟邀请作为实际参加辅导的「工具变量」。

examples.en: We listed the assumptions required before treating the lottery result as an instrumental variable.
examples.zh: 我们先列出了把抽签结果当作「工具变量」所需的假设。

words.enDefinition: a change in the value or volume of transactions within trade links that already exist

examples.en: Growth at the intensive margin of trade came from selling more of the same product to existing buyers.
examples.zh: 「贸易的集约边际」增长来自向现有买家销售更多同类产品。

examples.en: We measured the intensive margin of trade by tracking export volumes for established product and destination pairs.
examples.zh: 我们跟踪已有产品和目的地组合的出口数量，以衡量「贸易的集约边际」。

collocations: measure the intensive margin of trade
grow at the intensive margin of trade
compare the intensive margin of trade across markets

words.enDefinition: The effect of being assigned or offered treatment, regardless of whether a unit actually receives it.

examples.en: The intent-to-treat effect compares students by their assigned offer rather than by attendance in the simulation.
examples.zh: 这次模拟里的「意向处理效应」按学生是否被分配到获邀组比较，不按实际出席划分。

examples.en: We estimated the intent-to-treat effect even though some students did not attend the offered tutoring.
examples.zh: 尽管有些获邀学生没有参加辅导，我们仍估计了「意向处理效应」。

words.enDefinition: A model term formed from variables together to allow the relationship for one to differ with another.

examples.en: The interaction term allows the association with training to differ between workers with different experience levels.
examples.zh: 「交互项」允许培训的相关关系随劳动者的经验水平而不同。

examples.en: We added an interaction term so the fitted tutoring relationship could differ across the two school groups.
examples.zh: 我们加入一个「交互项」，允许两组学校的辅导关联有所不同。

words.enDefinition: Interest the US Federal Reserve pays eligible institutions on their reserve balances

examples.en: Our notes explain why interest on reserve balances matters when banks compare the returns on overnight assets.
examples.zh: 讲义解释了为什么银行比较隔夜资产收益时会关注「准备金余额利息」。

examples.en: The US example shows how interest on reserve balances helps guide overnight interest rates toward the target range.
examples.zh: 美国例子展示了「准备金余额利息」如何帮助引导隔夜利率向目标区间靠近。

collocations: rate of interest on reserve balances

words.enDefinition: Transmission of monetary policy through changes in borrowing costs and spending

examples.en: Our example traces the interest rate channel from a rate cut to lower loan costs.
examples.zh: 示例展示了「利率渠道」如何把降息传导为较低的贷款成本。

examples.en: We distinguished the interest rate channel from effects caused by banks changing credit standards.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「利率渠道」和银行调整信贷标准产生的影响。

collocations: effects of the interest rate channel

words.enDefinition: A situation in which the outcome for one unit depends on another unit's treatment assignment.

examples.en: Interference between units is possible when students in different groups share worked examples after the session.
examples.zh: 不同组的学生在课后分享解题示例时，可能出现「单位间干扰」。

examples.en: We considered interference between units before treating outcomes at the two nearby schools as unaffected by each other.
examples.zh: 把两所邻近学校的结果视为互不影响之前，我们先考虑了「单位间干扰」。

collocations: assumption of no interference between units

words.zhGloss: 投入选择的内点最优解
words.enDefinition: a best feasible input combination lying away from the boundaries, generally using positive quantities of all relevant inputs
acceptedZhAnswers: 投入选择的内点最优解

examples.en: An interior input optimum used both production inputs in positive quantities under the conditions of the example.
examples.zh: 在示例条件下，「投入选择的内点最优解」中两种生产要素的用量都为正。

examples.en: We compared the interior input optimum with an alternative where the producer used only one input.
examples.zh: 我们将「投入选择的内点最优解」与生产者只用一种要素的方案作了比较。

collocations: check conditions for an interior input optimum
compare an interior input optimum with a corner solution

words.enDefinition: Best feasible choice at which positive amounts of every good are selected

examples.en: The example has an interior solution because the shopper buys both kinds of fruit.
examples.zh: 这个例子有「内点解」，因为购物者两种水果都买。

examples.en: We first checked for an interior solution before comparing choices on the two axes.
examples.zh: 我们先检查有没有「内点解」，然后才比较两条坐标轴上的选择。

words.enDefinition: The value of goods and services used up as inputs in production, excluding the use of fixed assets.

examples.en: The bakery records flour and electricity as intermediate consumption when calculating the value it adds.
examples.zh: 在计算自身增加值时，面包店把面粉和电力归入「中间消耗」。

examples.en: The example construction firm includes the timber used during the quarter in its intermediate consumption.
examples.zh: 示例建筑公司把本季度耗用的木料计入「中间消耗」。

collocations: intermediate consumption of goods and services

words.enDefinition: To make a decision-maker face the outside costs or benefits created by their choices.

examples.en: The class asked whether a fee could internalise an externality created by extra traffic near campus.
examples.zh: 全班讨论收费能否「将外部性内部化」，这里的外部性来自校园附近新增的车流。

examples.en: Our worksheet compared two ways to internalise an externality from noise near the practice factory.
examples.zh: 练习表比较了两种将示例工厂周边噪声的「外部性内部化」的方法。

collocations: internalise an externality through a price
a policy designed to internalise an externality

words.enDefinition: a coordinated statistical programme comparing price levels and estimating purchasing power parities across economies

examples.en: We read an International Comparison Program summary before comparing prices in the two countries for similar goods.
examples.zh: 比较两个国家类似商品的价格之前，我们读了「国际比较项目」的概述。

examples.en: The report credited the International Comparison Program for the benchmark estimates underlying its comparison of real expenditure.
examples.zh: 报告说明实际支出比较所依据的基准估计来自「国际比较项目」。

words.enDefinition: a common purchasing-power unit with purchasing power equivalent to a US dollar in the United States for the stated comparison

examples.en: The table used the international dollar so comparable incomes could be displayed in a common purchasing-power unit.
examples.zh: 表格使用「国际元」，让可比收入能用一种共同购买力单位列出。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished an international dollar from a US dollar received in an actual currency exchange.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「国际元」与实际货币兑换中收到的一美元。

collocations: report an amount in international dollars
an international dollar at purchasing power parity

words.enDefinition: a statement of an economy's external financial assets and liabilities, including relevant reserve assets, at a given point in time

examples.en: The international investment position showed which foreign assets were held at the end of the reporting year.
examples.zh: 「国际投资头寸」显示报告年末持有哪些外国资产。

examples.en: We compared the international investment position with the year's transactions recorded in the financial account.
examples.zh: 我们把「国际投资头寸」与金融账户当年的交易数据作了比较。

collocations: publish an international investment position statement

words.enDefinition: a threshold in common purchasing-power units used to compare poverty across countries

examples.en: The study used an international poverty line rather than comparing two national thresholds quoted in different currencies.
examples.zh: 研究使用「国际贫困线」开展比较，避免直接使用以不同货币表示的两条国家贫困线。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the reference purchasing power parity year attached to the international poverty line in the dataset.
examples.zh: 导师核对了数据集中「国际贫困线」对应的购买力平价基准年度。

collocations: measure poverty at the international poverty line

words.enDefinition: the price of one good in international exchange relative to the price of another good

examples.en: The international relative price lay between the two economies' initial price ratios in our simple trade example.
examples.zh: 简单贸易示例中的「国际相对价格」介于两个经济体原有的价格比之间。

examples.en: The tutor changed the international relative price to show how the gains were shared between the economies.
examples.zh: 导师改变「国际相对价格」，演示收益如何在两个经济体之间分配。

collocations: compare the international relative price with domestic ratios
take the international relative price as given

words.enDefinition: exchanges where an economy both imports and exports goods in the same industry category

examples.en: The example showed intra-industry trade because both countries traded different models of bicycles with each other.
examples.zh: 两国彼此交易不同型号的自行车，示例体现了「产业内贸易」。

examples.en: We measured intra-industry trade after making sure both sets of bicycle exports used the same industry category.
examples.zh: 确认两组自行车出口使用同一行业分类之后，我们衡量了「产业内贸易」。

collocations: explain the growth of intra-industry trade

words.enDefinition: Rule giving a demand curve's price for each specified quantity

examples.en: We used the inverse demand function to find the price at which fifty passes sell.
examples.zh: 我们用「反需求函数」求出能卖出五十张通行证的价格。

examples.en: The homework asks us to put price on the left in the inverse demand function.
examples.zh: 作业要求我们把价格写在「反需求函数」等式的左边。

collocations: solve for the inverse demand function

words.enDefinition: for an interior single-price monopoly optimum, the price-cost margin as a share of price equals the inverse magnitude of demand elasticity

examples.en: The inverse elasticity rule linked the relative price margin to the responsiveness of demand at the monopoly optimum.
examples.zh: 「逆弹性定价规则」将垄断最优点的相对价格加价与需求响应程度联系起来。

examples.en: We applied the inverse elasticity rule to two separate groups under the assumptions used in our pricing exercise.
examples.zh: 在定价练习的假设下，我们对两个分开的群体应用了「逆弹性定价规则」。

collocations: state the assumptions of the inverse elasticity rule

words.enDefinition: Rule giving a supply curve's price for each specified quantity

examples.en: The inverse supply function gives the price at which local sellers offer twenty bikes for rent.
examples.zh: 「反供给函数」给出了当地商家愿意出租二十辆自行车时的价格。

examples.en: In the inverse supply function, quantity goes into the equation and price comes out.
examples.zh: 在「反供给函数」中，输入量是数量，输出量是价格。

collocations: solve for the inverse supply function

words.enDefinition: a line showing the input combinations that have the same total expenditure at specified input prices

examples.en: The isocost line showed combinations of worker hours and rented machine hours that cost the same amount.
examples.zh: 「等成本线」显示了总费用相同的人工工时和租用机器工时的组合。

examples.en: We redrew the isocost line after the machine hire price fell and the wage stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 机器租用价格下降、工资保持不变时，我们重新画了「等成本线」。

collocations: find a point on an isocost line

words.enDefinition: the negative ratio of the prices of the horizontal-axis input and the vertical-axis input on an isocost graph

examples.en: The isocost slope became more negative when the wage rose and labour was measured on the horizontal axis.
examples.zh: 工资上升且劳动量画在横轴上时，「等成本线斜率」变得更负。
