examples.en: The tutor marked non-additivity in the footnote beneath the table of chained figures.
examples.zh: 老师在链式数据表下的脚注里标明了「不可加总性」。

words.enDefinition: Output supplied to others for free or at prices that do not significantly influence supply and demand.

examples.en: The sample accounts classify the free public reading service as non-market output produced by the local government.
examples.zh: 示例账户把免费公共阅览服务归为地方政府提供的「非市场产出」。

examples.en: We compared the cost estimate for non-market output with the recorded sales of the bookshop.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「非市场产出」的成本估计和书店记录的销售额。

words.enDefinition: competing for buyers through product features, quality, service or other attributes apart from the prices charged

examples.en: The shops used non-price competition by making their opening hours more convenient and keeping their prices unchanged.
examples.zh: 商店调整营业时间以便顾客光顾，价格维持原样，采用了「非价格竞争」。

examples.en: We considered whether improved service illustrated non-price competition when rival sellers charged the same amount per visit.
examples.zh: 当竞争者每次收费相同时，我们考虑改善服务是否体现了「非价格竞争」。

collocations: study the effects of non-price competition

words.enDefinition: a restriction other than a tariff that impedes access to a foreign market

examples.en: The model added a non-tariff barrier that reduced shipments despite leaving the posted duty rate unchanged.
examples.zh: 模型加入一项「非关税壁垒」，尽管公布的关税税率不变，运输量仍减少了。

examples.en: The research team compared the costs imposed by a non-tariff barrier with those of an equivalent tariff.
examples.zh: 研究团队把「非关税壁垒」造成的成本与等效关税所造成的成本作了比较。

collocations: estimate the trade effects of a non-tariff barrier

words.enDefinition: a policy measure apart from an ordinary tariff that may affect international trade in goods or services

examples.en: The class recorded a non-tariff measure when the example required a product to meet specified labelling rules.
examples.zh: 示例要求产品符合指定标签规则时，同学们把它记录为「非关税措施」。

examples.en: We reviewed the non-tariff measure before estimating how it changed the cost of supplying the market.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「非关税措施」，再估计它怎样改变了向市场供货的成本。

collocations: estimate the effects of a non-tariff measure

words.enDefinition: the property of being costly or impractical to prevent particular people from benefiting from a good

examples.en: The example showed nonexcludability because the neighbourhood warning could reach households that had not contributed.
examples.zh: 社区预警也会传到没出资的家庭，例题以此说明「非排他性」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed nonexcludability before asking why a provider might struggle to collect payments from users.
examples.zh: 老师先讲了「非排他性」，再问提供者为什么可能难以向使用者收费。

words.enDefinition: US count of covered paid jobs at nonfarm establishments

examples.en: The class compared nonfarm payroll employment with the number of employed people from the household survey.
examples.zh: 全班比较了「非农就业岗位数」和住户调查中的就业人数。

examples.en: Our practice report showed nonfarm payroll employment holding steady even as manufacturing jobs declined.
examples.zh: 练习报告显示，尽管制造业岗位减少，「非农就业岗位数」总体持平。

words.enDefinition: The property that one user's consumption does not reduce what others can consume.

examples.en: The tutor illustrated nonrivalry with a notice that many people could read at the same time.
examples.zh: 老师用一则可供多人同时阅读的公告说明「非竞争性」。

examples.en: Our group questioned whether nonrivalry still held when the shared facility became crowded during the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论，课堂例题中的共享设施变得拥挤后，使用它是否仍有「非竞争性」。

collocations: an example of nonrivalry in use

words.enDefinition: Product whose demand increases when buyers' income rises, prices held fixed

examples.en: Takeaway meals are a normal good in our model because purchases increase when income rises.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，外带餐是「正常品」，因为收入增加时购买量也会增加。

examples.en: The worksheet asks whether fresh berries are a normal good for this household.
examples.zh: 习题问的是，对这个家庭而言鲜浆果是不是「正常品」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum return needed to keep the entrepreneur's resources in their current activity, included in economic cost

examples.en: The tutor counted normal profit as part of the opportunity cost of keeping capital in the shop.
examples.zh: 导师把「正常利润」视为让资本留在店里的机会成本的一部分。

examples.en: The small producer earned normal profit because its return matched the owner's best alternative use of those resources.
examples.zh: 小生产者的回报恰好等于业主将资源投入最佳替代用途的回报，因此获得的是「正常利润」。

collocations: include normal profit among economic costs

words.enDefinition: Counted as neither employed nor unemployed under the survey's criteria

examples.en: The US survey lists retirees with no job or job search as not in the labor force.
examples.zh: 美国调查将没有工作也没在找工作的退休人员归为「不在劳动力人口中」。

examples.en: She was not in the labor force while studying full time and taking a break from job searches.
examples.zh: 她全日制就读并暂停求职期间，「不在劳动力人口中」。

collocations: classified as not in the labor force
people not in the labor force
counted as not in the labor force

words.enDefinition: Units used as comparisons before their own treatment starts, although they may receive treatment later.

examples.en: The not-yet-treated comparison group includes schools due to start tutoring next year in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习里的「尚未处理比较组」包括预计明年启动辅导的学校。

examples.en: We updated the not-yet-treated comparison group once another set of fictional schools began the tutoring programme.
examples.zh: 另一批虚构学校开始辅导项目后，我们更新了「尚未处理比较组」。

words.enDefinition: A move another player can see or verify before making a relevant decision.

examples.en: The second club could respond because the room booking was an observable move in the model.
examples.zh: 因为模型中的教室预订是「可观察行动」，第二个社团可以作出回应。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the initial offer counted as an observable move for all participants.
examples.zh: 老师问，对所有参与者而言，最初的提议是否属于「可观察行动」。

collocations: distinguish an observable move from a hidden one
condition a choice on an observable move

words.enDefinition: A possible sequence of moves given zero probability by the equilibrium strategies.

examples.en: The tutor checked an off-equilibrium path to see how the second club would respond to an unexpected offer.
examples.zh: 老师核查了一条「均衡外路径」，看第二个社团会怎样回应意料之外的提议。

examples.en: We labelled the off-equilibrium path that began with an action excluded by the proposed strategies.
examples.zh: 我们标出了一条「均衡外路径」，它起于拟议策略不会选择的行动。

collocations: analyse choices on an off-equilibrium path
specify beliefs after an off-equilibrium path

words.enDefinition: official support for economic development and welfare that meets OECD DAC eligibility and concessionality criteria

examples.en: The report separated official development assistance from commercial financing for the sample infrastructure projects.
examples.zh: 报告将「官方发展援助」与示例基础设施项目的商业融资分开列示。

examples.en: We checked whether official development assistance was reported as flows or using the grant equivalent measure.
examples.zh: 我们核查「官方发展援助」采用资金流量还是赠款等值口径列报。

collocations: compare official development assistance across years

words.enDefinition: external assets readily available to and controlled by monetary authorities for external financing and related policy purposes

examples.en: The table listed official reserve assets separately from foreign securities owned by private households in the same economy.
examples.zh: 表格将「官方储备资产」与同一经济体中私人家庭持有的外国证券分开列出。

examples.en: We compared the reported official reserve assets with the level shown at the end of the previous year.
examples.zh: 我们把报告中的「官方储备资产」与上一年末的水平作了比较。

collocations: measure changes in official reserve assets

words.enDefinition: a market structure in which relatively few firms account for most of the activity and closely affect one another

examples.en: The lecture described an oligopoly where each of three sellers paid close attention to the others' output decisions.
examples.zh: 课上描述了一个「寡头垄断」市场，其中三家卖家都密切关注对手的产量决策。

examples.en: We compared the oligopoly example with an industry where each of many small firms could ignore individual rivals.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「寡头垄断」示例和另一行业，在后者众多小厂商可以忽略某一家对手。

words.enDefinition: The relative period left out of an event study so coefficients refer to changes from that period.

examples.en: The omitted event period is the year immediately before tutoring starts in this classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，「省略的事件参照期」是辅导启动前一年。

examples.en: We named the omitted event period in the chart caption to make the comparison clear.
examples.zh: 我们在图注里注明「省略的事件参照期」，使比较基准更清楚。

words.enDefinition: The category left out of a regression indicator set so other category differences are measured relative to it.

examples.en: The table names the omitted reference category below the estimates for the three training groups.
examples.zh: 表格在三个培训组的估计值下方注明「省略的参照类别」。

examples.en: Changing the omitted reference category changes which group each displayed coefficient is compared against.
examples.zh: 更换「省略的参照类别」会改变表中各系数所对应的比较基准组。

words.enDefinition: Bias that occurs when an omitted cause of the outcome is associated with an included regressor.

examples.en: Omitted variable bias can arise when prior skills affect wages and are associated with schooling.
examples.zh: 先前技能影响工资且与受教育程度有关时，可能产生「遗漏变量偏误」。

examples.en: The workshop asks how omitted variable bias could change the estimated association between training and pay.
examples.zh: 工作坊要求解释「遗漏变量偏误」可能怎样改变培训与工资的估计关系。

words.enDefinition: In suitable dynamic games, the rule that checking single-decision deviations suffices to verify equilibrium at every subgame.

examples.en: We applied the one-shot deviation principle by changing one action and keeping the remaining strategy fixed.
examples.zh: 我们应用「单次偏离原理」，改变一次行动，同时保持策略的其余部分不变。

examples.en: The worksheet tested the one-shot deviation principle at every decision in the small scheduling game.
examples.zh: 练习表在小型排期博弈的每个决策点检验了「单次偏离原理」。

collocations: use the one-shot deviation principle to verify an equilibrium
check the assumptions of the one-shot deviation principle

words.enDefinition: A resource with no effective rule limiting who may use or extract from it.

examples.en: The classroom model treated the fishery as an open access resource with no effective limit on entry.
examples.zh: 课堂模型把这个没有有效准入限制的渔场视为「开放使用资源」。

examples.en: We compared an open access resource with a pond that only designated households could use.
examples.zh: 我们比较了一项「开放使用资源」与只有指定家庭才能使用的一处池塘。

collocations: compare an open access resource with restricted access

words.enDefinition: Central bank market transactions used to manage reserves or implement policy

examples.en: The textbook illustrates open market operations with a central bank purchase of government securities.
examples.zh: 教材用央行购买政府证券的例子说明「公开市场操作」。

examples.en: Our class compared open market operations with borrowing directly from the central bank's lending facility.
examples.zh: 全班把「公开市场操作」与直接通过央行贷款工具借款作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Affordable choice that best satisfies the buyer's preferences in a model

examples.en: At the new prices, our model predicts an optimal consumption bundle with more train rides.
examples.zh: 按新价格，我们的模型得出了包含更多火车出行的「最优消费组合」。

examples.en: The problem asks us to find the optimal consumption bundle after the student receives extra income.
examples.zh: 这道题要求在学生获得额外收入之后求出「最优消费组合」。

words.enDefinition: Representation of preference rankings without measuring differences in satisfaction between choices

examples.en: With ordinal utility, a score of ten means a higher rank than five.
examples.zh: 在「序数效用」中，十分只表示排序高于五分。

examples.en: The example uses ordinal utility to rank bundles without comparing the size of utility gains.
examples.zh: 例子用「序数效用」给消费组合排序，并把效用增加了多少留在排序之外。

words.enDefinition: A method that estimates regression coefficients by minimizing the sum of squared residuals.

examples.en: The class used ordinary least squares to estimate the association between schooling and hourly pay.
examples.zh: 全班使用「普通最小二乘法」估计受教育程度与小时工资之间的关联。

examples.en: In the worksheet, ordinary least squares selects the line with the smallest squared residual sum.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「普通最小二乘法」选出残差平方和最小的一条直线。

words.enDefinition: the rate charged on imports outside the lower-rate allocation under a tariff-rate quota

examples.en: The table assigned the out-of-quota tariff to the portion of imports above the model's lower-rate limit.
examples.zh: 表格把「配额外关税」用于超过模型低税率额度的那部分进口。

examples.en: We checked whether paying the out-of-quota tariff still made importing worthwhile in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们检查在课堂模型里，支付「配额外关税」后继续进口是否仍划算。

words.enDefinition: The difference between actual and potential output, often expressed as a percentage of potential output.

examples.en: The output gap is negative when actual production falls below potential production in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中，实际生产低于潜在生产时，「产出缺口」为负。

examples.en: We calculated the output gap using two series in comparable real terms for the same quarter.
examples.zh: 我们使用同一季度两个以可比实际量表示的序列计算「产出缺口」。

words.enDefinition: Total output divided by the number of workers producing it during the period.

examples.en: The model measures output per worker by dividing total production by the number of workers.
examples.zh: 模型将总产量除以劳动者人数，算出「每名劳动者产出」。

examples.en: We compared output per worker in two branches with the same number of employees.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两家雇员人数相同的分支机构的「每名劳动者产出」。

words.enDefinition: An alternative available to a participant outside the agreement being negotiated.

examples.en: One club had an outside option because another room was available for its workshop.
examples.zh: 因为还有另一间教室可用于举办工作坊，一个社团拥有「谈判外选择」。

examples.en: The tutor added an outside option to see whether the first club would accept fewer shared hours.
examples.zh: 老师加入一个「谈判外选择」，看看第一个社团是否会接受更少的共享时数。

collocations: compare an offer with an outside option
include an outside option in the game

words.enDefinition: Use of a natural resource at a rate that depletes it or undermines its long-term renewal.

examples.en: The model predicted overexploitation when total fishing exceeded the rate at which the stock could recover.
examples.zh: 总捕捞量超过鱼群的恢复速度时，模型预测会出现「过度开发利用」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed overexploitation after the simulation showed a smaller fish population in later rounds.
examples.zh: 模拟显示后续轮次鱼群数量减少之后，老师讨论了「过度开发利用」。

words.enDefinition: The assumption that comparable covariate profiles have positive probabilities of being both treated and untreated.

examples.en: The overlap assumption fails in the example when every student with a certain score receives tutoring.
examples.zh: 示例中，当某一分数的学生全部接受辅导时，「重叠性假设」不成立。

examples.en: We examined the observed scores to assess whether the overlap assumption looked plausible in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看实测分数，评估「重叠性假设」是否可信。

words.enDefinition: In an externality model, production beyond the quantity that maximizes net social benefits.

examples.en: The model predicted overproduction because sellers did not face the damage caused by each extra unit.
examples.zh: 卖家无需承担每增加一个单位所造成的损害，模型因此预测会有「过度生产」。

examples.en: We marked the range of overproduction between the market quantity and the socially efficient quantity.
examples.zh: 我们在市场数量和社会有效数量之间标出了「过度生产」的范围。

collocations: overproduction caused by an external cost

words.enDefinition: Price of the good whose demand or supply is being studied

examples.en: We held tea prices fixed and changed the own price of coffee in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型里，我们保持茶的价格不变，只改变咖啡的「本品价格」。

examples.en: Focus on the product's own price before examining the prices of its substitutes.
examples.zh: 在研究替代品的价格之前，先看这种商品的「本品价格」。

words.enDefinition: Estimated rental value of owner-occupied housing services in the US consumer index

examples.en: The US index uses owners' equivalent rent to track the cost of living in owned homes.
examples.zh: 美国的指数使用「业主等价租金」衡量住在自有住房里的成本。

examples.en: We compared owners' equivalent rent with actual tenant rents in the table's housing section.
examples.zh: 在统计表的住房部分，我们比较了「业主等价租金」和租户实际支付的租金。

words.enDefinition: Data that follow the same units, such as people or schools, over multiple periods.

examples.en: The panel data follow the same schools from two years before tutoring to two years afterward.
examples.zh: 这组「面板数据」跟踪同一批学校，从辅导开始前两年一直到开始后两年。

examples.en: We used panel data to compare each fictional student's attendance before and after a change.
examples.zh: 我们用「面板数据」比较每名虚构学生在某项变化前后的出勤情况。

words.expression: parallel shift of the budget line
words.lemma: parallel shift of the budget line
words.enDefinition: Movement of the spending boundary while the relative prices stay constant
acceptedEnVariants: parallel shift of the budget line

examples.en: A larger weekly allowance caused a parallel shift of the budget line in our class exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂习题里，每周零花钱增加导致了「预算线平行移动」。

examples.en: The graph shows a parallel shift of the budget line because both prices stayed the same.
examples.zh: 因为两样商品的价格都没变，图上显示的是「预算线平行移动」。

collocations: outward parallel shift of the budget line
inward parallel shift of the budget line
illustrate a parallel shift of the budget line

words.enDefinition: the assumption that the compared groups' average outcomes would have changed by the same amount over the relevant periods without treatment

examples.en: The parallel trends assumption concerns the changes that would have occurred without tutoring in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「平行趋势假设」针对的是没有辅导时本会发生的变化。

examples.en: We stated the parallel trends assumption before showing the curves for the two fictional groups.
examples.zh: 我们先说明「平行趋势假设」，再展示两个虚构组的曲线。

collocations: violation of the parallel trends assumption

words.enDefinition: A change making at least one person better off without making anyone worse off.

examples.en: The trade represented a Pareto improvement because one participant gained and nobody in the model lost.
examples.zh: 因为有一位参与者获益且模型中无人受损，这笔交易构成「帕累托改进」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether a positive total gain alone proved a Pareto improvement for the group.
examples.zh: 老师问，总增益为正本身是否足以证明这项变化对小组构成「帕累托改进」。

words.enDefinition: US category for workers involuntarily working fewer than full-time hours for economic reasons

examples.en: Workers unable to find full-time work may be classified as working part time for economic reasons.
examples.zh: 无法找到全职工作的人，可能被归为「因经济原因兼职」。

examples.en: The US release reports workers employed part time for economic reasons alongside other measures of labor underutilization.
examples.zh: 美国这份报告把「因经济原因兼职」的人数和其他劳动力利用不足指标一同列出。

collocations: working part time for economic reasons
employed part time for economic reasons
counted as part time for economic reasons

words.enDefinition: The change in the model outcome associated with a change in one variable while other variables remain fixed.

examples.en: The partial effect of schooling in the example is evaluated at a fixed level of experience.
examples.zh: 示例中，在工作经验水平不变时评估受教育程度的「偏效应」。

examples.en: In the nonlinear model, the partial effect varies with the initial level of the explanatory variable.
examples.zh: 在非线性模型中，「偏效应」随解释变量的初始水平而变化。

words.enDefinition: an equilibrium weakly preferred by every player to the other equilibria, with at least one player strictly preferring it to each alternative considered

examples.en: The example's payoff-dominant equilibrium gave both clubs more points than coordinating on the smaller room.
examples.zh: 例题中的「收益占优均衡」比双方协调使用小教室时给两个社团更多积分。

examples.en: We checked the payoffs of both teams before labelling one outcome a payoff-dominant equilibrium.
examples.zh: 在把一个结果称为「收益占优均衡」之前，我们核查了两个小组的收益。

collocations: compare a payoff-dominant equilibrium with another outcome
a payoff-dominant equilibrium in a coordination game

words.enDefinition: A rule assigning a numerical payoff to a player for each outcome or combination of strategies.

examples.en: The payoff function gave each team extra points when both booked the same workshop session.
examples.zh: 两队预订同一场工作坊时，「收益函数」给每队额外积分。

examples.en: The tutor changed the payoff function to include the inconvenience of using the smaller room.
examples.zh: 老师修改「收益函数」，计入使用小教室所带来的不便。

words.enDefinition: A table of payoffs for the combinations of strategies in a strategic-form game.

examples.en: The payoff matrix showed the points both groups received for each pair of arrival times.
examples.zh: 「收益矩阵」显示每对到达时刻下两个小组各自所得的积分。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a payoff matrix to compare choices made without seeing the other group's decision.
examples.zh: 老师画了一个「收益矩阵」，比较双方都看不到对方决定时作出的选择。

collocations: fill in the cells of a payoff matrix

words.enDefinition: The ordering of a player's possible results from higher to lower payoff or the reverse.

examples.en: The payoff ranking changed after the worksheet increased the value of using the larger room.
examples.zh: 练习表提高使用大教室的价值后，「收益排序」发生了变化。

examples.en: We checked whether both clubs had the same payoff ranking for the three booking outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们核对了两个社团对三种预订结果的「收益排序」是否相同。

words.enDefinition: The ordered list of numerical payoffs received by all players at a particular outcome.

examples.en: The payoff vector listed the first team's points before the points awarded to the second team.
examples.zh: 「收益向量」先列第一队的积分，再列第二队获得的积分。

examples.en: We compared each payoff vector to see whether both groups gained from sharing the studio.
examples.zh: 我们对比各个「收益向量」，查看共用工作室能否让两组都受益。

words.zhGloss: 个人消费支出价格指数
words.enDefinition: US measure of prices for goods and services consumed by households
acceptedZhAnswers: 个人消费支出价格指数

examples.en: The US PCE price index includes certain purchases made on behalf of households, such as medical services.
examples.zh: 美国「个人消费支出价格指数」包含某些由他人为家庭支付的项目，例如医疗服务。

examples.en: The lecture compared the PCE price index with a consumer index that used different spending weights.
examples.zh: 课堂比较了「个人消费支出价格指数」与另一种采用不同支出权重的消费价格指数。

collocations: annual change in the PCE price index

words.enDefinition: The size of the fall in a measure between its cyclical high and the following low.

examples.en: The peak-to-trough decline was larger for industrial production than for total output in this example.
examples.zh: 示例中，工业生产的「峰谷降幅」大于总产出的降幅。

examples.en: We measured the peak-to-trough decline separately from the length of the contraction in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用练习纸分别衡量「峰谷降幅」和收缩持续时长。

words.enDefinition: A payment of a specified amount for each qualifying unit produced, bought, or sold.

examples.en: The classroom example paid a per-unit subsidy for every additional basket sold under the scheme.
examples.zh: 在课堂例题中，该计划对每多售出的一个篮子提供「单位商品定额补贴」。

examples.en: We compared the per-unit subsidy with a fixed payment that did not depend on quantity sold.
examples.zh: 我们把「单位商品定额补贴」与不随销量变化的固定付款作了比较。

collocations: calculate the cost of a per-unit subsidy

words.enDefinition: A tax charging a fixed amount for each unit of a good sold or activity undertaken.

examples.en: The classroom model used a per-unit tax that charged the same amount for every basket sold.
examples.zh: 课堂模型采用「单位商品定额税」，每卖出一个篮子都征收相同金额。

examples.en: We drew the price difference created by a per-unit tax in the simple market model.
examples.zh: 我们画出了「单位商品定额税」在简单市场模型中造成的价格差。

collocations: compare a per-unit tax with a percentage tax

words.enDefinition: The amount that one component adds to or subtracts from an overall percentage growth rate.

examples.en: The table gives the percentage point contribution of household spending to growth in total output.
examples.zh: 表格给出住户支出对总产出增长的「百分点贡献」。

examples.en: We compared the percentage point contribution of services with the corresponding figure for goods.
examples.zh: 我们把服务的「百分点贡献」与货物的相应数据作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Strategies and beliefs such that decisions are sequentially rational and beliefs follow Bayes' rule where applicable.

examples.en: The worksheet listed both strategies and beliefs before testing a perfect Bayesian equilibrium in the sequential example.
examples.zh: 练习表先列出策略和信念，再检验序贯例题中的「完美贝叶斯均衡」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the response to an unexpected offer when evaluating the proposed perfect Bayesian equilibrium.
examples.zh: 老师在评估拟议的「完美贝叶斯均衡」时，核查了对意外提议的回应。

collocations: specify beliefs in a perfect Bayesian equilibrium

words.enDefinition: a model with many price-taking producers, a homogeneous product, and no substantial barriers to entry or exit

examples.en: Under perfect competition, the small seller in our exercise could sell at the market price without influencing it.
examples.zh: 在「完全竞争」下，练习中的小卖家可以按市场价格销售，但无法影响该价格。

examples.en: We compared perfect competition with a case where producers could set different prices for differentiated products.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「完全竞争」和生产者可以对差异化产品收取不同价格的情形。

collocations: analyse a market under perfect competition

words.enDefinition: Goods that increase satisfaction only when consumed together in fixed proportions

examples.en: Our example treats left and right gloves as perfect complements because they work in pairs.
examples.zh: 这个例子把左手和右手手套当作「完全互补品」，因为它们要成对使用。

examples.en: We drew right angles to represent indifference curves for perfect complements in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们把「完全互补品」的无差异曲线画成直角形。

words.enDefinition: A game in which each player observes the complete previous history whenever they make a decision.

examples.en: The perfect-information game let each group see all earlier choices before making its next move.
examples.zh: 「完美信息博弈」让各组在作出下一次行动前看见所有先前选择。

examples.en: Our tutor showed where the second club moved in the perfect-information game about allocating rooms.
examples.zh: 老师展示了在分配教室的「完美信息博弈」中，第二个社团在哪一步行动。

collocations: use backward induction in a perfect-information game

words.enDefinition: An exact linear relationship among regressors that prevents their separate coefficients from being uniquely determined.

examples.en: Perfect multicollinearity arises because the worksheet includes both a full set of group indicators and an intercept.
examples.zh: 练习同时包含整套组别指示变量和截距，因此出现「完全多重共线性」。

examples.en: The tutor showed why perfect multicollinearity prevents separate estimates for two redundant explanatory variables.
examples.zh: 老师说明了为什么「完全多重共线性」会导致两个信息重复的解释变量无法分别估计系数。

words.enDefinition: Goods exchangeable at a constant rate without changing a buyer's satisfaction

examples.en: The model treats identical notebooks from the two stores as perfect substitutes for this buyer.
examples.zh: 在该模型中，两家店出售的同款笔记本对这名买家而言是「完全替代品」。

examples.en: In our simple drawing, the indifference curves for perfect substitutes are straight lines.
examples.zh: 在我们的简单示意图中，「完全替代品」的无差异曲线是直线。

words.enDefinition: Demand represented by a horizontal curve at a single price

examples.en: The tutor drew perfectly elastic demand as a flat line at the reference price.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用基准价格处的一条水平线表示「完全弹性需求」。

examples.en: With perfectly elastic demand in our model, no buyers remain if a seller charges above the stated price.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型里，如果卖家定价高于图示价格，「完全弹性需求」意味着该卖家不会留有买家。

words.enDefinition: the horizontal demand curve seen by an individual price-taking firm at the market price in the competitive model

examples.en: Our graph showed perfectly elastic firm demand at the market price while market demand sloped downward.
examples.zh: 图上总市场需求曲线向下倾斜，但「厂商的完全弹性需求」曲线在市场价格处是水平的。

examples.en: In the model, perfectly elastic firm demand meant the producer would sell nothing at a higher price.
examples.zh: 在模型里，存在「厂商的完全弹性需求」，因此生产者若定价高于市价，就什么也卖不出去。

collocations: draw a line for perfectly elastic firm demand
contrast perfectly elastic firm demand with market demand

words.enDefinition: Supply represented by a horizontal curve at a single price

examples.en: Our perfectly elastic supply line stays horizontal when the market demand curve shifts right.
examples.zh: 市场需求曲线右移时，我们画的「完全弹性供给」线仍保持水平。

examples.en: The model assumes perfectly elastic supply so that rising demand changes quantity but leaves price fixed.
examples.zh: 模型假设存在「完全弹性供给」，因此需求上升会改变数量，但价格固定。

words.enDefinition: Demand whose quantity remains fixed as the product's own price changes

examples.en: We drew a vertical line to represent perfectly inelastic demand in a simplified market model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的市场模型中画了一条竖线表示「完全无弹性需求」。

examples.en: The example assumes perfectly inelastic demand for ten permits at all prices on the diagram.
examples.zh: 该例假设图示所有价格下的需求量都是十张许可证，属于「完全无弹性需求」。

words.enDefinition: Supply whose quantity offered remains fixed as its price changes

examples.en: The model assumes perfectly inelastic supply because the number of available seats stays fixed.
examples.zh: 模型假定存在「完全无弹性供给」，因为可用座位数量保持不变。

examples.en: Our first graph shows perfectly inelastic supply as a vertical line through capacity for the hall.
examples.zh: 第一张图用一条经过场馆容量值的竖线表示「完全无弹性供给」。

words.zhGloss: 完全可替代的投入要素
words.enDefinition: production inputs that can replace one another at a fixed rate without changing output
acceptedZhAnswers: 完全可替代的投入要素

examples.en: The worksheet used perfectly substitutable inputs that provided the same work per hour on either machine.
examples.zh: 练习设定两台机器每小时完成相同工作，把它们视为「完全可替代的投入要素」。

examples.en: We drew a straight isoquant in the example with perfectly substitutable inputs and a fixed replacement rate.
examples.zh: 在「完全可替代的投入要素」按固定比率互换的示例中，我们画了一条直线形的等产量曲线。

collocations: draw an isoquant for perfectly substitutable inputs

words.enDefinition: A regulatory requirement specifying an outcome to meet while leaving some choice over how to meet it.

examples.en: The simulated performance standard set a noise limit while letting workshops choose how to meet it.
examples.zh: 模拟中的「绩效标准」设定噪声限值，同时允许工场自行选择达标方法。

examples.en: We compared a performance standard with a rule that required every firm to install identical equipment.
examples.zh: 我们把「绩效标准」与要求每家企业安装同一种设备的规定作了比较。

collocations: set a performance standard for emissions

words.enDefinition: A sale of emissions allowances to participants through competitive bidding.

examples.en: The classroom permit auction gave teams an opportunity to bid for the simulation's initial allowances.
examples.zh: 课堂「排放配额拍卖」给各队竞买模拟初始配额的机会。

examples.en: We compared revenue from the permit auction with revenue under free allocation in our exercise.
examples.zh: 我们对比了练习中「排放配额拍卖」和免费分配两种情形下的收入。

collocations: report revenue from a permit auction

words.enDefinition: Saving unused emissions allowances for use in a later period when a trading program permits it.

examples.en: The simulation allowed permit banking, so unused allowances could be carried into the following period.
examples.zh: 模拟允许「配额结转」，因此未用完的配额可以带到下一期。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why permit banking might change the timing of reductions in a classroom model.
examples.zh: 老师问，「配额结转」为什么可能改变课堂模型中的减排时间。

collocations: compare scenarios with and without permit banking

words.enDefinition: the market or auction price of a tradable emissions allowance

examples.en: The simulated permit price rose when several factories wanted to buy allowances in the same round.
examples.zh: 几家工厂都想在同一轮购买配额时，模拟中的「排放配额价格」上涨了。

examples.en: We compared the permit price with the cost of reducing one more unit in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「排放配额价格」与练习中再减排一个单位的成本作比较。

collocations: compare the permit price with abatement cost
report a change in the permit price

words.enDefinition: current transfers in cash or kind between resident and nonresident households under balance of payments reporting

examples.en: The example recorded household support sent to relatives resident in another country as personal transfers.
examples.zh: 示例把寄给居住在另一国的亲属的家庭资助记为「个人间经常转移」。

examples.en: We compared personal transfers received by households with the cross-border wages listed in a different income category.
examples.zh: 我们比较住户收到的「个人间经常转移」和另一收入类别所列的跨境工资。

words.enDefinition: Model relationship between inflation or wage growth and labor market slack

examples.en: The lecturer introduced the Phillips curve using inflation and unemployment on separate axes.
examples.zh: 老师用分别标注通胀和失业的两条坐标轴介绍了「菲利普斯曲线」。

examples.en: We compared the Phillips curve across periods with different inflation expectations in the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了模型中通胀预期不同的各个时期的「菲利普斯曲线」。

words.enDefinition: Responsiveness of modeled inflation to a specified change in unemployment or slack

examples.en: We compared the Phillips curve slope in two models using the same unemployment measure.
examples.zh: 我们用相同的失业指标比较了两个模型中的「菲利普斯曲线斜率」。

examples.en: The smaller magnitude of the Phillips curve slope implies a weaker inflation response in our diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的图中，「菲利普斯曲线斜率」的绝对值越小，意味着通胀对失业变动的反应越弱。

collocations: change in the Phillips curve slope

words.enDefinition: Produced assets such as equipment and buildings that are used to make goods or provide services.

examples.en: The model treats the workshop and its machinery as physical capital used in production.
examples.zh: 模型把车间和其中的机器视为生产用的「实物资本」。

examples.en: We increased the stock of physical capital in the simulation by adding two additional machines.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中加了两台机器，增加了「实物资本」存量。

words.enDefinition: A corrective tax that prices a negative externality, set at marginal external cost at the efficient quantity in the benchmark model.

examples.en: The tutor drew a Pigouvian tax equal to the marginal external cost at the efficient quantity.
examples.zh: 老师画出一项「庇古税」，其额度等于有效数量处的边际外部成本。

examples.en: We compared a Pigouvian tax with a classroom rule that simply limited the amount of pollution.
examples.zh: 我们把「庇古税」与课堂模型中直接限制排放量的规定作了比较。

collocations: compare a Pigouvian tax with a cap

words.enDefinition: Rotation of the spending boundary around one unchanged maximum affordable quantity

examples.en: A lower pasta price caused a pivot of the budget line around the bread intercept.
examples.zh: 意大利面降价引起了「预算线旋转」，旋转中心是面包轴上的截距。

examples.en: We illustrated a pivot of the budget line after the bus fare rose while lunch prices stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 在公交票价上涨、午餐价格保持不变时，我们演示了「预算线旋转」。

collocations: inward pivot of the budget line
outward pivot of the budget line
illustrate a pivot of the budget line

words.enDefinition: An artificial cutoff with no known treatment change, used to check for unexplained discontinuities.

examples.en: The placebo cutoff is set at a score where no eligibility rule changes in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「安慰剂阈值」设在资格规则没有发生变化的分数处。

examples.en: We explained why a jump at a placebo cutoff would complicate interpreting the main result.
examples.zh: 我们解释为什么在「安慰剂阈值」处出现跳变会让主要结果更难解释。

words.enDefinition: An outcome used in a diagnostic because it should not be causally affected by the treatment.

examples.en: The study uses scores recorded before tutoring as a placebo outcome in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习用辅导前记录的成绩作为「安慰剂结果变量」。

examples.en: We explained why an estimated effect on the placebo outcome would raise doubts about comparability.
examples.zh: 我们解释，为什么估计发现处理影响「安慰剂结果变量」会让人怀疑各组是否可比。

words.enDefinition: A diagnostic that tests for an effect in a deliberately chosen situation where the treatment should have none.

examples.en: The placebo test pretends tutoring started a year earlier to check for an apparent premature effect.
examples.zh: 「安慰剂检验」假定辅导提前一年开始，以检查是否会估计出过早出现的效应。

examples.en: An unexpected estimate in the placebo test led us to revisit the assignment assumptions in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「安慰剂检验」出现意外估计值后，我们重新检查了分配假设。

words.enDefinition: A player's private information or characteristics that matter for payoffs or beliefs in a game.

examples.en: The example assigned a player type according to how much each club valued the larger room.
examples.zh: 例题根据各社团对大教室的重视程度给它们分配「参与者类型」。

examples.en: We listed the available responses for each player type before analysing the classroom auction.
examples.zh: 分析课堂拍卖之前，我们列出了各「参与者类型」可选的回应。

collocations: infer a player type from observed choices
condition a strategy on player type

words.enDefinition: Measure of proportional responsiveness at one point on a curve

examples.en: We used point elasticity to study a very small price change near the current price.
examples.zh: 我们用「点弹性」研究当前价格附近的一次微小变动。

examples.en: The formula for point elasticity uses both price and quantity at the marked point.
examples.zh: 「点弹性」公式同时用到了标记点处的价格和数量。

words.enDefinition: The estimated outcome that would have occurred without the policy or under a specified alternative.

examples.en: Our group defined a policy counterfactual before estimating the reduction in traffic from the trial fee.
examples.zh: 我们组先设定「政策反事实情景」，再估计试验性收费减少了多少车流。

examples.en: The tutor showed how choosing a different policy counterfactual changed the apparent benefits of the intervention.
examples.zh: 老师展示了选择不同的「政策反事实情景」如何改变干预措施所显示的收益。

collocations: test sensitivity to the policy counterfactual

words.enDefinition: Interest rate a central bank sets or targets to implement policy

examples.en: Our model raises the policy rate before tracing what happens to borrowing and spending.
examples.zh: 我们的模型先提高「政策利率」，再追踪借款和支出的变化。

examples.en: The statement explained why the committee held the policy rate steady in the scenario.
examples.zh: 这份声明解释了在该情景下委员会为何维持「政策利率」不变。

words.enDefinition: Characterization of policy as stimulating, neutral, or restraining economic activity

examples.en: We used estimated real interest rates to discuss the model's monetary policy stance.
examples.zh: 我们用估计的实际利率讨论模型中的货币「政策立场」。

examples.en: The report calls the policy stance restrictive even after a small reduction in rates.
examples.zh: 尽管利率已小幅下调，报告仍将「政策立场」称为限制性的。

words.enDefinition: Action that prevents or reduces the amount of pollution generated or released.

examples.en: The model compared pollution abatement at two factories facing the same financial incentive to reduce releases.
examples.zh: 模型比较了两家面对同样减排激励的工厂采取的「污染减排」。

examples.en: Our group measured pollution abatement relative to the level the simulation would have produced without controls.
examples.zh: 我们组以模拟中未设置管控时的排放量为参照，测量了「污染减排」量。

collocations: measure the cost of pollution abatement

words.enDefinition: an equilibrium of a signalling model in which different types choose the same observable action, so it does not distinguish them

examples.en: The model had a pooling equilibrium when both types of seller made the same observable offer.
examples.zh: 两种类型的卖家都给出相同的可观察报价时，模型形成「混同均衡」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what buyers could infer about quality under the proposed pooling equilibrium.
examples.zh: 老师问，在设想的「混同均衡」下，买家能对质量推断出什么。

collocations: compare a pooling equilibrium with a separating one

words.enDefinition: cross-border transactions in equity and debt securities, excluding direct investment, reserve assets and financial derivatives under external accounts rules

examples.en: The report separated portfolio investment flows from direct investment by residents buying controlling interests in businesses abroad.
examples.zh: 报告将「证券投资流量」与居民买入境外企业控制性权益而形成的直接投资分开列示。

examples.en: We compared portfolio investment flows in two quarters after checking whether the source reported net or gross transactions.
examples.zh: 确认来源报告净额还是总额后，我们比较了两个季度的「证券投资流量」。

collocations: compare portfolio investment flows across periods

words.enDefinition: An uncompensated benefit that an activity creates for others outside the relevant decision or transaction.

examples.en: The example showed a positive externality when a workshop shared a design that neighbouring groups could use.
examples.zh: 工作坊分享了邻近小组可以使用的设计，例题展示了由此产生的「正外部性」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked who received the positive externality from caring for trees beside the campus path.
examples.zh: 老师问，养护校园小径旁的树所产生的「正外部性」惠及了谁。

words.enDefinition: The outcome a unit would have under a specified treatment condition, whether observed or unobserved.

examples.en: The potential outcome under training is observed for the fictional worker who actually received it.
examples.zh: 在虚构案例中，实际参加培训的劳动者在接受培训条件下的「潜在结果」可以观测。

examples.en: Our worksheet describes a potential outcome for each of the two possible treatment conditions.
examples.zh: 练习纸分别描述了两种可能处理条件下的「潜在结果」。

words.enDefinition: The level of production an economy can sustain with a normal use of labour and capital.

examples.en: Potential output rises in the model after productivity improves across the fictional economy's main industries.
examples.zh: 虚构经济体的主要行业生产率提高后，模型中的「潜在产出」上升。

examples.en: We compared potential output with the level actually recorded in the quarter shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较「潜在产出」与练习所示季度实际记录的产出水平。

words.enDefinition: The increase over time in an economy's estimated sustainable level of production.

examples.en: Potential output growth slows in the example after the rate of productivity improvement falls.
examples.zh: 示例中，生产率改善速度下降后，「潜在产出增长」放缓。

examples.en: We separated potential output growth from changes related to the economy's short-term recovery in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「潜在产出增长」与经济短期复苏带来的变化区分开。

words.enDefinition: the average shortfall below the poverty threshold across the population as a share of the line, counting zero for everyone at or above it

examples.en: The poverty gap index rose when households already below the threshold moved farther below it in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，原本就在贫困线下的家庭离贫困线更远时，「贫困差距指数」上升了。

examples.en: We compared the poverty gap index for two regions with the same number of people below the line.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个贫困线下人数相同地区的「贫困差距指数」。

collocations: interpret a change in the poverty gap index

words.enDefinition: the share of the relevant population living below a specified income or consumption poverty threshold

examples.en: The poverty headcount ratio fell after several households moved slightly above the threshold in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中几户家庭刚刚越过贫困线，「贫困人口比率」随之下降。

examples.en: We compared the poverty headcount ratio using two thresholds and reported how the results differed.
examples.zh: 我们用两条贫困线计算「贫困人口比率」，并报告结果的差异。

words.enDefinition: a reference year for which purchasing power parities are estimated directly through a comparison programme rather than extrapolated

examples.en: The note identified the PPP benchmark year underlying the later estimates extrapolated with other price measures.
examples.zh: 附注列出了「购买力平价基准年」，后续数据由这个基准和其他价格指标推算得出。

examples.en: We kept the PPP benchmark year consistent when comparing the source's two estimates of real household spending.
examples.zh: 比较同一来源对实际家庭支出的两项估计时，我们采用相同的「购买力平价基准年」。

collocations: compare figures from the same PPP benchmark year

words.enDefinition: The pattern of outcome changes in periods before a unit or group receives treatment.

examples.en: The pre-treatment trend in attendance looks similar across the two schools in the classroom graph.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，两所学校出勤率的「处理前趋势」看起来相近。

examples.en: We looked at the pre-treatment trend before interpreting the large difference that appeared after tutoring.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「处理前趋势」，再解读辅导实施后出现的较大差异。

words.enDefinition: A check for systematic differences in group trends before treatment, which may reveal concerns about identification.

examples.en: The pre-trend test checks whether estimated differences were already changing before the hypothetical programme began.
examples.zh: 「处理前趋势检验」查看在假设项目开始前，估计差异是否已经在变化。

examples.en: The tutor explained why passing a pre-trend test cannot establish the required counterfactual trend assumption.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么通过「处理前趋势检验」无法证实所需的反事实趋势假设。

words.enDefinition: Ranking of alternatives according to which options a consumer likes better

examples.en: The new utility numbers preserved the student's preference ordering over all three meal plans.
examples.zh: 新的效用数值保留了该学生对三个膳食方案的原有「偏好排序」。

examples.en: In the table, our preference ordering puts the bundle with two apples first.
examples.zh: 在表中，我们的「偏好排序」把含两个苹果的组合排在第一位。

words.enDefinition: a tariff rate under a preference arrangement for goods meeting its eligibility rules

examples.en: The model showed a preferential tariff for goods that qualified under the specified regional agreement.
examples.zh: 模型显示符合指定区域协定条件的商品适用「优惠关税」。

examples.en: We compared the preferential tariff with the general rate when reading two columns of the table.
examples.zh: 看表中两列数据时，我们把「优惠关税」和一般税率作了比较。

words.enDefinition: rivalry in which firms compete for buyers by changing the prices they charge

examples.en: The price competition in the model intensified after a new seller offered an almost identical service.
examples.zh: 新卖家推出几乎完全相同的服务后，模型里的「价格竞争」加剧了。

examples.en: We compared price competition with a scenario where firms chose only their production quantities before any sale.
examples.zh: 我们将「价格竞争」与厂商在销售前只选择产量的情形作比较。

words.enDefinition: Path of optimal bundles as one price changes and income stays fixed

examples.en: Our price-consumption curve connects the best bundles at three different prices for rice.
examples.zh: 我们的「价格消费曲线」连接大米处于三个不同价格时各自的最优组合。

examples.en: We used the price-consumption curve to see how a fare change affects both choices.
examples.zh: 我们用「价格消费曲线」研究车费变动如何同时影响两种选择。

collocations: derive demand from the price-consumption curve

words.enDefinition: Ratio of the percentage change in purchases to that in price

examples.en: We calculated the price elasticity of demand for rides from two prices on the same curve.
examples.zh: 我们根据同一条曲线上的两个价格计算乘车服务的「需求价格弹性」。

examples.en: The model gives the price elasticity of demand for notebooks under the assumption that incomes stay fixed.
examples.zh: 该模型在收入保持不变的假设下，给出了笔记本的「需求价格弹性」。

collocations: estimate the price elasticity of demand

words.enDefinition: Ratio of the percentage change in quantity supplied to that in price

examples.en: The worksheet compares the price elasticity of supply for bakery bread over two different periods.
examples.zh: 习题比较了两个时期内面包店所售面包的「供给价格弹性」。

examples.en: A steeper curve alone cannot tell us the price elasticity of supply at this point.
examples.zh: 仅凭曲线更陡，无法确定该点的「供给价格弹性」。

collocations: calculate the price elasticity of supply

words.enDefinition: the condition for an interior output optimum for a price-taking firm with differentiable costs, subject to profitability and second-order conditions

examples.en: The tutor checked where price equals marginal cost before deciding whether the competitive producer should operate.
examples.zh: 导师先检查何处「价格等于边际成本」，再判断这个竞争性生产者是否应该开工。

examples.en: Our diagram marked the point where price equals marginal cost on the increasing part of the cost curve.
examples.zh: 示意图在成本曲线上升段标出了「价格等于边际成本」的点。

collocations: find the quantity where price equals marginal cost
compare output where price equals marginal cost

words.enDefinition: Price where a graph crosses its vertical axis at zero quantity

examples.en: To find the price intercept, we set quantity to zero in the new supply equation.
examples.zh: 为求出「价格轴截距」，我们把新供给方程中的数量设为零。

examples.en: Our graph labels the price intercept above the point where the two curves cross.
examples.zh: 我们的图把「价格轴截距」标在两条曲线交点的上方。

words.enDefinition: an index comparing price levels across economies by relating purchasing power parity to the corresponding market exchange rate

examples.en: The price level index showed which economy had higher overall prices relative to the common reference point.
examples.zh: 「跨国价格水平指数」显示相对于共同参考点，哪个经济体的总体价格更高。

examples.en: We checked the reference economy before comparing two published values of the price level index for consumption.
examples.zh: 比较两项公布的消费「跨国价格水平指数」前，我们核对了参考经济体。

collocations: choose a reference for a price level index

words.enDefinition: Standard diagram convention putting price on the graph's up and down scale

examples.en: We put price on the vertical axis and then marked bus trips on the horizontal axis.
examples.zh: 我们把「价格放在纵轴上」，然后在横轴标出公交出行次数。

examples.en: With price on the vertical axis, the height of the intersection gives the market clearing price.
examples.zh: 当「价格位于纵轴上」时，交点的高度给出市场出清价格。

collocations: plot price on the vertical axis
show price on the vertical axis
put price on the vertical axis

words.enDefinition: a producer that can choose the price of its product subject to the demand it faces

examples.en: The price-setting firm compared the profit at several prices before choosing the one paired with its preferred output.
examples.zh: 「价格制定厂商」比较几个价格下的利润，再选择与最适合的产量对应的价格。

examples.en: We showed how a price-setting firm could lose buyers if it raised the price of its service.
examples.zh: 我们演示了「价格制定厂商」提高服务价格后可能怎样流失顾客。

collocations: analyse the demand facing a price-setting firm
compare a price-setting firm with a price taker

words.enDefinition: Condition of low and sufficiently stable inflation over the relevant horizon

examples.en: Our example treats price stability as compatible with small movements in relative prices.
examples.zh: 我们的例子认为，「物价稳定」与相对价格的小幅变动可以并存。

examples.en: The lesson explains why the central bank's measure of price stability covers many prices.
examples.zh: 课堂解释了为什么央行衡量「物价稳定」的指标涵盖许多价格。

words.enDefinition: a market participant that treats the prevailing market price as given when choosing how much to buy or sell

examples.en: Each producer was a price taker since its sales were small relative to the whole market.
examples.zh: 在农场模型中，各生产者的销量与整个市场相比很小，所以都是「价格接受者」。

examples.en: The tutor asked what would happen if one price taker tried charging above the prevailing market price.
examples.zh: 导师问，如果一个「价格接受者」尝试报出高于现行市场价格的售价，结果会怎样。

collocations: assume a firm is a price taker
describe the behaviour of a price taker

words.enDefinition: the BPM6 current account category for cross-border compensation, investment income and other specified primary income

examples.en: The BPM6 primary income account included dividends from abroad paid to resident companies in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例里，BPM6「初次收入账户」纳入了境外支付给居民企业的股息。

examples.en: Our tutor checked where cross-border wages appeared within the primary income account of the example economy.
examples.zh: 导师查看在示例经济体的「初次收入账户」里，跨境工资列在哪一项。

collocations: record income in the primary income account
explain a change in the primary income account

words.enDefinition: A conflict that arises when someone acting for another party has different incentives and their actions are hard to observe.

examples.en: The case illustrated a principal-agent problem because the owner and the contractor valued extra effort differently.
examples.zh: 所有者与承包方对额外投入的重视程度不同，案例以此说明「委托代理问题」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how limited information about effort shaped the principal-agent problem in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师解释了关于努力程度的信息有限，如何影响练习中的「委托代理问题」。

collocations: address a principal-agent problem with incentives

words.enDefinition: a game in which defection is individually dominant for each player while mutual cooperation gives both a better outcome

examples.en: The tutor illustrated a prisoner's dilemma with two clubs deciding whether to contribute to a shared project.
examples.zh: 老师用两个社团决定是否为共同项目出资来说明「囚徒困境」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked why both groups ended up with fewer points in the prisoner's dilemma example.
examples.zh: 练习表问，为什么「囚徒困境」例题中的两个小组最终都拿到较少积分。

collocations: identify the incentives in a prisoner's dilemma
play a repeated version of the prisoner's dilemma

words.enDefinition: Negotiation between affected parties to agree how to address a cost, benefit or shared concern.

examples.en: The example used private bargaining to show how two neighbours could agree on quieter delivery times.
examples.zh: 例题用「私人协商」展示两个邻居如何就噪声较少的送货时间达成一致。

examples.en: Our class compared private bargaining in a two-person example with a case involving an entire neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 全班对比了两人例题里的「私人协商」和涉及整个街区的案例。

collocations: reach an agreement through private bargaining

words.enDefinition: A good that users can be excluded from and whose consumption reduces availability for others.

examples.en: The class used a sandwich as a private good because it could be sold and consumed individually.
examples.zh: 全班用三明治举例说明「私人物品」，因为它可以卖给个人并被个人食用。

examples.en: We compared a private good sold at the kiosk with the information displayed outside for everyone.
examples.zh: 我们把售货亭出售的一种「私人物品」与外面供所有人查看的信息作了比较。

collocations: classify a product as a private good
contrast a private good with a public good

words.enDefinition: An auction in which each bidder knows their own value and learning others' valuations does not change it.

examples.en: The classroom private-value auction gave each participant a known personal value for the same sample book.
examples.zh: 课堂「私有价值拍卖」给每位参与者设定了自己已知的示例图书估值。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which assumptions made the game a private-value auction in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 老师问，在课堂练习中，哪些假设使这场博弈属于「私有价值拍卖」。

collocations: compare a private-value auction with a common-value auction

words.enDefinition: Tending to rise during expansions and fall during contractions, moving with overall economic activity.

examples.en: Investment is procyclical in our example and grows when broader economic activity is also rising.
examples.zh: 示例中的投资是「顺周期的」，整体经济活动上升时，投资也增长。

examples.en: The class described the series as procyclical after comparing it with the fictional output cycle.
examples.zh: 把这个序列与虚构的产出周期比较后，全班认为它是「顺周期的」。

words.enDefinition: Tax and spending choices that amplify expansions or downturns in aggregate activity

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates procyclical fiscal policy by reducing public spending when private demand already falls.
examples.zh: 习题以私人需求已经下滑时削减公共支出为例说明「顺周期财政政策」。

examples.en: We compared procyclical fiscal policy with a response designed to cushion the modeled downturn.
examples.zh: 我们将「顺周期财政政策」与旨在缓冲模型中经济下行的政策反应作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Measure of price changes received by domestic producers in the US framework

examples.en: The US producer price index tracks what sellers receive for their output in the example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，美国「生产者价格指数」追踪卖家出售产品所得的价格。

examples.en: We compared the producer price index with a consumer series covering a different spending basket.
examples.zh: 我们把「生产者价格指数」和覆盖不同消费篮子的消费者数据作了比较。

collocations: changes in the producer price index

words.enDefinition: the range of distinct product versions available to buyers in a market

examples.en: The model predicted more product variety when new cafes could enter and serve customers with different tastes.
examples.zh: 模型预测新咖啡馆能进入市场服务口味不同的顾客时，「产品品种多样性」将提高。

examples.en: We compared the benefits of product variety with the cost of operating more production lines overall.
examples.zh: 我们将「产品品种多样性」的收益与总体运行更多生产线的成本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A method of measuring GDP from industries' value added, with any adjustments needed to reach market prices.

examples.en: The production approach starts with the value each industry adds to the goods it produces.
examples.zh: 核算采用「生产法」时，从各行业生产货物所创造的增加值算起。

examples.en: We used the production approach to build GDP from the example economy's industry accounts.
examples.zh: 我们用「生产法」，从示例经济体的产业账户推算 GDP。

collocations: estimate output using the production approach

words.enDefinition: The rule defining which activities count as production in a system of national accounts.

examples.en: The tutor used two household activities to show where the production boundary falls in the accounts.
examples.zh: 老师用两项住户活动说明国民账户的「生产边界」划在哪里。

examples.en: The class discussed why unpaid cooking for one's own household lies outside this production boundary.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了为什么在自己家中无偿做饭处于这一「生产边界」以外。

words.enDefinition: An outside benefit or cost created by producing a good or service.

examples.en: The model treated factory noise as a production externality affecting people in the surrounding area.
examples.zh: 模型把工厂噪声看作影响周边居民的「生产外部性」。

examples.en: We compared two processes to see whether either created a production externality in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两种工艺，看其中是否有一种在课堂案例中产生了「生产外部性」。

collocations: estimate the effect of a production externality

words.enDefinition: Goods or services produced and retained by the same unit for its own consumption or capital formation.

examples.en: The sample farm keeps some of its grain, which the accounts record as production for own use.
examples.zh: 示例农场留下一部分谷物，国民账户将这部分记为「自用生产」。

examples.en: The exercise classifies a firm's construction of its own warehouse as production for own use.
examples.zh: 练习把企业自行建造自用仓库归为「自用生产」。

collocations: production for own use by households
production for own use as capital

words.enDefinition: a curve showing combinations of inputs that produce the same specified amount of output

examples.en: The production isoquant showed how more machine hours could substitute for some labour at unchanged output.
examples.zh: 「等产量曲线」显示在产量不变时，增用机器工时如何替代一部分人工。

examples.en: We drew a production isoquant for one hundred units before considering any changes in input prices.
examples.zh: 考虑投入要素价格变化之前，我们先画出产量为一百件的「等产量曲线」。

collocations: choose a point on a production isoquant

words.enDefinition: the methods and feasible relationships determining what output can be produced from available inputs

examples.en: The model assumed the same production technology for both workshops before comparing their choices of labour and machines.
examples.zh: 模型先假定两家车间采用同一种「生产技术」，再比较它们对劳动和机器的选择。

examples.en: We discussed how changes in production technology might increase output without increasing resource use.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「生产技术」的变化如何在资源用量不增加的情况下提高产量。

words.enDefinition: A measure of assets in use that weights them by their remaining productive capacity.

examples.en: The productive capital stock declines in the example as older machines lose some working capacity.
examples.zh: 示例中，老旧机器的工作能力有所下降，因此「生产性资本存量」减少。

examples.en: The exercise estimates productive capital stock separately for buildings and equipment with different service lives.
examples.zh: 练习分别估计使用寿命不同的建筑物和设备的「生产性资本存量」。

words.enDefinition: A decline in the rate at which productivity increases over time.

examples.en: The productivity slowdown begins when output per hour keeps rising but at a lower rate.
examples.zh: 每小时产出仍在增加但增速降低时，就出现「生产率增速放缓」。

examples.en: The chart shades the years of the productivity slowdown in the fictional region's manufacturing sector.
examples.zh: 图表为虚构地区制造业发生「生产率增速放缓」的年份加了阴影。

words.enDefinition: the quantity producing the highest difference between total revenue and total economic cost among feasible choices

examples.en: The profit-maximising output fell when the demand curve facing the producer shifted inward in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型里，生产者面对的需求曲线内移后，「利润最大化产量」下降了。

examples.en: We checked the profit-maximising output against an option of producing nothing before accepting the graph's result.
examples.zh: 在接受图上结论之前，我们把「利润最大化产量」与零产量方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the price that yields the greatest attainable profit for the producer under the stated demand and costs

examples.en: We found the profit-maximising price by reading the demand curve at the output selected in the monopoly example.
examples.zh: 我们在垄断示例所选的产量处读取需求曲线，找到「利润最大化价格」。

examples.en: The profit-maximising price in the exercise changed when customer demand became more responsive to price.
examples.zh: 顾客需求对价格更敏感后，练习中的「利润最大化价格」发生变化。

words.enDefinition: A change in a player's strategy that improves its own payoff when the others do not change theirs.

examples.en: The first team found a profitable deviation because switching rooms gave it more points in that row.
examples.zh: 第一队找到了一个「有利偏离」，因为在该行换教室能让它获得更多积分。

examples.en: Our tutor checked for a profitable deviation before calling the pair of choices an equilibrium.
examples.zh: 老师先查看是否存在「有利偏离」，再把这对选择称为均衡。

collocations: identify a profitable deviation from an outcome

words.enDefinition: The probability of treatment conditional on a set of observed characteristics.

examples.en: The propensity score uses observed grades and attendance to estimate tutoring participation in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「倾向得分」利用实测成绩和出勤率估计参加辅导的概率。

examples.en: We compared the estimated propensity score distributions of the two groups before making any outcome comparisons.
examples.zh: 在比较结果之前，我们先比较两组估计的「倾向得分」分布。

words.enDefinition: A subgame starting after the beginning of the original game and therefore excluding some of it.

examples.en: The diagram marked a proper subgame beginning after the second group received the opening proposal.
examples.zh: 图中标出一个「真子博弈」，它从第二组收到初始提议之后开始。

examples.en: We checked the proper subgame separately before studying the strategy profile from the original starting point.
examples.zh: 我们先单独检查「真子博弈」，再研究从原起点出发的策略组合。

collocations: count proper subgames in the tree

words.enDefinition: Size of a difference relative to a base rather than in units

examples.en: Comparing proportional change lets us use the same scale for dollars and ticket counts.
examples.zh: 比较「比例变动」可以把美元价格和门票数量放在同一尺度上。

examples.en: We calculated the proportional change in demand using its initial value as the base.
examples.zh: 我们用需求量的初始值作基数来计算「比例变动」。

words.enDefinition: A good whose use is nonrival and from which people are difficult to exclude.

examples.en: The example treated a warning reaching all nearby households at once as a public good.
examples.zh: 例题把能同时传达给附近各户的预警视为「公共物品」。

examples.en: We checked both characteristics before calling the shared information service a public good in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中将这项共享信息服务称为「公共物品」前，我们核查了它是否具备两项特征。

collocations: classify a service as a public good

words.enDefinition: An experiment or model where individuals choose contributions to a fund or activity that benefits the group.

examples.en: In the public goods game, each classroom token contributed to the fund benefited both teams.
examples.zh: 在「公共物品博弈」中，投入基金的每枚课堂代币都惠及两队。

examples.en: We compared contributions in the public goods game before and after participants saw the earlier group totals.
examples.zh: 我们比较了参与者看到此前各组合计前后，在「公共物品博弈」中的出资。

collocations: measure contributions in a public goods game

words.enDefinition: The arrangement of a good or service by government or another public body.

examples.en: The case compared public provision of neighbourhood lighting with relying on individual households to pay separately.
examples.zh: 案例对比由「公共部门提供」社区照明和依靠各家住户分别出资这两种情形。

examples.en: Our class asked whether public provision of the service also required staff to be public employees.
examples.zh: 全班问，由「公共部门提供」服务是否也要求工作人员必须受雇于公共部门。

collocations: compare public provision with private provision
fund public provision of a service

words.enDefinition: The amount the purchaser pays for a good or service, apart from any deductible value added tax.

examples.en: The purchaser's price in the exercise includes a delivery charge shown on a separate line.
examples.zh: 练习中的「购买者价格」包括单独列出的送货费。

examples.en: We checked the purchaser's price against the amount paid to take delivery of the sample goods.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「购买者价格」与接收示例货物时支付的金额。

words.enDefinition: the domestic currency units needed to purchase the equivalent of one common purchasing-power unit for a specified aggregate

examples.en: The table listed the purchasing power parity conversion factor beside the exchange rate for the same reference year.
examples.zh: 表中将「购买力平价换算因子」与同一参考年度的汇率并排列出。

examples.en: We used the purchasing power parity conversion factor to compare the purchasing power of the example incomes.
examples.zh: 我们用「购买力平价换算因子」比较示例收入的购买力。

collocations: apply a purchasing power parity conversion factor
compare purchasing power parity conversion factors
check the reference year of a purchasing power parity conversion factor

words.enDefinition: A deterministic plan assigning an action at every possible information set of the player.

examples.en: The exercise asked us to write a pure strategy with a definite response to every possible offer.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们写出一种「纯策略」，为每个可能的提议确定明确的回应。

examples.en: Our first pure strategy always selected the early slot, regardless of the other team's choice.
examples.zh: 我们的第一种「纯策略」总是选择较早的时段，无论另一队怎么选。

collocations: specify a pure strategy on a game tree

words.enDefinition: A Nash equilibrium in which each player uses a deterministic strategy.

examples.en: The exercise had a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium where both clubs chose the same afternoon session.
examples.zh: 练习存在一个「纯策略纳什均衡」，两个社团都选同一场下午活动。

examples.en: We checked each cell to see whether the classroom contest had a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium.
examples.zh: 我们逐格检查课堂竞赛是否存在「纯策略纳什均衡」。

collocations: show a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium in the matrix

words.enDefinition: A squared regressor included to let the fitted slope vary with the regressor's value.

examples.en: The quadratic term lets the fitted relationship between experience and wages bend in our classroom graph.
examples.zh: 「二次项」使课堂图里的经验与工资拟合关系可以呈现曲线。

examples.en: We kept the linear part when adding a quadratic term for experience to the model.
examples.zh: 我们往模型中加入经验的「二次项」时，保留了一次项。

words.zhGloss: 质量调整后的劳动投入
words.enDefinition: A measure of labour input that accounts for both hours worked and changes in worker characteristics.
acceptedZhAnswers: 质量调整后的劳动投入

examples.en: Quality-adjusted labour input changes when the mix of qualifications changes even with stable total hours.
examples.zh: 即使总工时保持不变，资格构成有变化，「质量调整后的劳动投入」也会变化。

examples.en: The worksheet compares quality-adjusted labour input with a simple measure of total hours worked.
examples.zh: 练习纸比较了「质量调整后的劳动投入」和简单的总工时指标。

words.enDefinition: Adjustment separating changes in a product's characteristics from changes in its price

examples.en: The index uses a quality adjustment after a laptop model is replaced by a faster version.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑换成速度更快的型号后，该指数使用了「质量调整」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained quality adjustment using two refrigerators with different features and electricity use.
examples.zh: 老师用两款功能和耗电量不同的冰箱说明了「质量调整」。

words.enDefinition: Uncertainty about a product's actual quality at the time an exchange is being considered.

examples.en: Quality uncertainty made the hypothetical buyers unwilling to offer more for the best used equipment.
examples.zh: 由于「质量不确定性」，假设中的买家不愿为最好的二手设备出更高的价。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a verified inspection might reduce quality uncertainty in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 老师问，经核实的检验结果可能怎样减少课堂例题中的「质量不确定性」。

collocations: model quality uncertainty in a secondhand market

words.enDefinition: Checking evidence to establish whether product or service quality matches the information provided.

examples.en: The model included the cost of quality verification when buyers requested an independent condition check.
examples.zh: 买家要求独立检查设备状况时，模型计入了「质量核验」成本。

examples.en: Our group discussed how better quality verification could increase trade in the example used goods market.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了更完善的「质量核验」可能怎样增加例题中二手商品市场的成交量。

words.enDefinition: Large-scale central bank asset purchases intended to ease broader financial conditions

examples.en: We studied quantitative easing as a policy option when short-term rates were already low.
examples.zh: 我们把「量化宽松」作为短期利率已经很低时的一种政策选项来研究。

examples.en: The model examines how quantitative easing could affect long-term yields through asset purchases.
examples.zh: 模型研究了「量化宽松」如何通过购买资产影响长期收益率。

words.enDefinition: Reduction in a central bank's asset holdings through maturities or sales

examples.en: The case illustrates quantitative tightening by letting some government bonds mature without replacing them.
examples.zh: 案例用部分政府债券到期后不再补购的做法来说明「量化紧缩」。

examples.en: Our discussion covers how quantitative tightening may affect reserves as the central bank's portfolio shrinks.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了央行持有的资产规模收缩时，「量化紧缩」可能如何影响准备金。

words.enDefinition: rivalry in which firms choose quantities and the market price depends on combined output under the model

examples.en: The quantity competition exercise asked each producer to select output before observing the resulting market price.
examples.zh: 「产量竞争」练习让各生产者先选择产量，再观察由此形成的市场价格。

examples.en: We drew each producer's preferred output for different levels of rival output in the quantity competition example.
examples.zh: 我们为「产量竞争」例题中的各生产者画出在不同对手产量下最合适的产量。

collocations: compare quantity competition with price competition

words.enDefinition: Amount buyers are willing and able to buy at a given price

examples.en: We used the table to find the quantity demanded for notebooks at three dollars.
examples.zh: 我们查表找出了笔记本售价为三美元时的「需求量」。

examples.en: At the lower price, the quantity demanded rose from forty packs to fifty.
examples.zh: 价格下降后，「需求量」从四十包增至五十包。

words.enDefinition: Quantity where a graph crosses its horizontal axis at zero price

examples.en: I used the quantity intercept to read the predicted number of rides at zero price.
examples.zh: 我用「数量轴截距」读出了模型在价格为零时预测的乘车次数。

examples.en: The quantity intercept is farther right on the demand graph after student income rises.
examples.zh: 学生收入增加后，需求图的「数量轴截距」向右移了。

words.enDefinition: Amount sellers are willing and able to sell at a given price

examples.en: The table shows the quantity supplied for each possible price of a used textbook.
examples.zh: 这张表列出了二手教材在每个可能价格下的「供给量」。

examples.en: At five dollars a bag, what is the quantity supplied in the example?
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，每袋五美元时的「供给量」是多少？

words.enDefinition: A percentage change compared with the immediately preceding quarter.

examples.en: Quarter-on-quarter growth compares the second quarter directly with the first quarter of the same year.
examples.zh: 「季度环比增长」直接把第二季度和同年的第一季度作比较。

examples.en: We calculated quarter-on-quarter growth from the seasonally adjusted figures in the practice accounts.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习账户中的季节调整后数据，算出了「季度环比增长」。

words.enDefinition: US voluntary separations relative to employment, excluding retirements and transfers

examples.en: The quits rate fell in our example even though the number of layoffs rose.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，尽管裁员人数增加，「主动离职率」仍然下降。

examples.en: We used the quits rate to compare voluntary departures across sectors of different sizes.
examples.zh: 我们用「主动离职率」比较规模不同的行业中主动离职的情况。

words.enDefinition: the surplus obtained from the ability to import under a binding quota when the domestic price exceeds the import cost

examples.en: The exercise calculated quota rent after local prices rose above the cost of bringing in the permitted imports.
examples.zh: 当地价格超过获准进口商品的成本后，练习计算了「配额租金」。

examples.en: We compared who would receive quota rent under different arrangements for allocating scarce import rights.
examples.zh: 我们比较在不同稀缺进口权分配方式下，谁会获得「配额租金」。

words.enDefinition: A panel model that treats unit-specific effects as random components, conventionally assumed unrelated to the regressors.

examples.en: The random effects model assumes the school component is unrelated to the explanatory variables in this exercise.
examples.zh: 这项练习的「随机效应模型」假定学校效应分量与各解释变量无关。

examples.en: We discussed the assumptions behind the random effects model before comparing it with fixed effects.
examples.zh: 将「随机效应模型」与固定效应模型比较之前，我们先讨论其背后的假设。

collocations: assumptions of a random effects model

words.enDefinition: Forecasts using available information consistently with the model, without systematic forecast errors

examples.en: We assumed rational expectations while allowing unexpected supply shocks to cause individual forecast errors.
examples.zh: 我们假定「理性预期」成立，同时允许意外的供给冲击造成个别预测误差。

examples.en: Under rational expectations, the model's forecast incorporates the policy announcement when it becomes known.
examples.zh: 在「理性预期」下，公众了解政策公告后，模型预测会把相关政策考虑进去。

words.enDefinition: A strategy that is a best response to a belief about other strategies consistent with common belief in rationality.

examples.en: The worksheet asked which belief about the other team's choice could support a rationalizable strategy.
examples.zh: 练习表问，关于另一队选择的哪一种信念能支持一个「可理性化策略」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed that a rationalizable strategy could remain even when it appeared in no Nash equilibrium.
examples.zh: 老师说明，一个「可理性化策略」即使没有出现在任何纳什均衡中，也可能保留下来。

collocations: test whether a strategy is a rationalizable strategy
a belief supporting a rationalizable strategy

words.enDefinition: A distance scale around the cutoff used to choose or weight observations for a discontinuity estimate.

examples.en: The RD bandwidth determines how far from the cutoff observations contribute to the local estimate.
examples.zh: 「断点回归带宽」决定距阈值多远的观测会用于局部估计。

examples.en: We used a smaller RD bandwidth to focus the classroom exercise on scores near eligibility.
examples.zh: 我们使用较小的「断点回归带宽」，让课堂练习聚焦资格阈值附近的成绩。

words.enDefinition: an exchange rate between two currencies adjusted for relative price levels in the two economies

examples.en: The real bilateral exchange rate took account of the higher domestic prices shown for the second year.
examples.zh: 「实际双边汇率」计入了第二年所列国内价格较高的因素。

examples.en: Our class calculated the real bilateral exchange rate after aligning the price measures and the currency quote convention.
examples.zh: 同学们统一价格指标和货币报价口径后，计算了「实际双边汇率」。

collocations: calculate a real bilateral exchange rate
interpret movements in the real bilateral exchange rate

words.enDefinition: Disposable income adjusted for changes in prices to represent what that income can buy.

examples.en: Real disposable income fell in the worksheet because prices rose faster than the available money income.
examples.zh: 练习中，价格涨幅超过可支配货币收入涨幅，因此「实际可支配收入」下降。

examples.en: We compared real disposable income across two periods after reading the footnote about the price index.
examples.zh: 我们阅读有关价格指数的脚注后，比较了两个时期的「实际可支配收入」。

words.enDefinition: an index of a currency against multiple partner currencies adjusted for relative prices or costs under stated weights

examples.en: We compared the real effective exchange rate with its nominal counterpart after domestic prices outpaced partner prices.
examples.zh: 国内价格上涨速度超过贸易伙伴后，我们把「实际有效汇率」与其名义指标作了比较。

examples.en: The report described which price index it used to calculate the real effective exchange rate in the table.
examples.zh: 报告说明它用哪个价格指数计算表中的「实际有效汇率」。

collocations: calculate a real effective exchange rate
report the real effective exchange rate
compare changes in real effective exchange rates

words.enDefinition: GDP adjusted for changes in prices so its movements reflect changes in the volume of production.

examples.en: Real GDP is unchanged in our example because the economy produces the same quantities as before.
examples.zh: 由于示例经济体的生产量与以前相同，「实际国内生产总值」保持不变。

examples.en: The class compared real GDP over three quarters to see whether production had grown.
examples.zh: 全班比较了三个季度的「实际国内生产总值」，查看生产是否有所增长。

words.enDefinition: Interest rate adjusted for either observed or expected inflation

examples.en: We approximated the real interest rate by subtracting expected inflation from the nominal rate.
examples.zh: 我们从名义利率中减去预期通胀率，估算了「实际利率」。

examples.en: In our example, the real interest rate rose even though the quoted rate stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子里，尽管公布的利率保持不变，「实际利率」仍上升了。

words.enDefinition: An index that tracks changes in the volume of output relative to a selected reference period.

examples.en: The real output index rises when factories make a greater volume of goods in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，工厂生产的货物量增多时，「实际产出指数」上升。

examples.en: We used the real output index to compare the path of production across the two periods.
examples.zh: 我们用「实际产出指数」比较两个时期的生产变动轨迹。

collocations: change in the real output index

words.enDefinition: Wage measured by its purchasing power after adjustment for prices

examples.en: The real wage fell in our example because pay rose more slowly than prices.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，工资增速低于价格涨幅，因此「实际工资」下降了。

examples.en: We divided the money wage by a price index to estimate the real wage.
examples.zh: 我们将货币工资除以价格指数来估算「实际工资」。

words.enDefinition: To rescale an index so a newly selected reference period has the stated reference value.

examples.en: The exercise asks us to rebase an index so its value is one hundred in the selected year.
examples.zh: 练习让我们「为指数重设基期」，使其在选定年份的数值为一百。

examples.en: We learned to rebase an index without changing the percentage movements between its observations.
examples.zh: 我们学会了在保留观测值之间百分比变动的情况下「为指数重设基期」。

collocations: rebase an index to a new year
rebase an index to one hundred

words.enDefinition: A negative gap that occurs when actual output falls below potential output in a macroeconomic model.

examples.en: In our diagram, the recessionary gap lies between the current equilibrium and the higher potential output.
examples.zh: 图中，「衰退性产出缺口」位于当前均衡产出与更高的潜在产出之间。

examples.en: We measured the recessionary gap along the horizontal output axis in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂模型的横向产出轴测量「衰退性产出缺口」。

words.enDefinition: Delay before policymakers recognize a change in the state of the economy

examples.en: The model includes a recognition lag because economic statistics arrive after conditions change.
examples.zh: 模型有「识别时滞」，因为经济形势变化后，相关统计数据才会发布。

examples.en: The class discussed the recognition lag when later revisions revealed an earlier downturn.
examples.zh: 后续修订揭示了更早发生的经济下行，全班讨论了其中的「识别时滞」。

words.enDefinition: The early part of an expansion that follows a downturn, when activity starts regaining lost ground.

examples.en: The recovery phase begins as the fictional economy starts to regain the production it lost.
examples.zh: 虚构经济体开始恢复先前损失的生产量时，进入「复苏阶段」。

examples.en: In the first months of the recovery phase, total output remained below its earlier level.
examples.zh: 「复苏阶段」的头几个月，总产出仍低于之前的水平。

words.enDefinition: The change in the outcome associated with a change in the instrument before scaling by its first-stage effect.

examples.en: The reduced-form effect compares mean scores by the offer in the randomized classroom tutoring example.
examples.zh: 在课堂随机辅导示例中，「简约式效应」根据是否获得邀请比较平均成绩。

examples.en: We divided the reduced-form effect by the first-stage difference in the simple binary example.
examples.zh: 在简单二元示例中，我们将「简约式效应」除以第一阶段差异。

words.enDefinition: A year chosen to set the scale of an index or chained monetary series.

examples.en: The reference year has an index value of one hundred in the national accounts example.
examples.zh: 在国民账户示例中，「参考年」的指数值为一百。

examples.en: We changed the reference year, which rescaled the chain index without changing its growth rates.
examples.zh: 我们更换「参考年」后，链式指数的数值基准改变，增长率仍相同。

words.enDefinition: an agreement among two or more trading parties that grants reciprocal preferential treatment under defined terms

examples.en: The class mapped the members of a regional trade agreement before comparing their average rates on imports.
examples.zh: 比较各方平均进口税率前，同学们先在地图上标出这份「区域贸易协定」的成员。

examples.en: We discussed which goods a hypothetical regional trade agreement would cover and how trade might change.
examples.zh: 我们讨论一份假想「区域贸易协定」会涵盖哪些商品，以及贸易可能怎样变化。

collocations: review the coverage of a regional trade agreement

words.enDefinition: A parameter attached to an explanatory term that determines how that term enters the fitted outcome.

examples.en: The regression coefficient gives the fitted pay change for one more year of schooling at fixed experience.
examples.zh: 在工作经验不变时，「回归系数」给出受教育年限每增加一年对应的工资拟合变化。

examples.en: We checked the units of the regression coefficient before describing its size in the report.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「回归系数」的单位，再在报告里解释系数大小。

words.enDefinition: A design that uses a cutoff in treatment assignment to estimate an effect near the cutoff under stated assumptions.

examples.en: The regression discontinuity design compares students with scores just above and below the fictional eligibility cutoff.
examples.zh: 「断点回归设计」比较得分刚超过和刚低于虚构资格门槛的学生。

examples.en: We stated the assignment rule before explaining why the regression discontinuity design was plausible here.
examples.zh: 我们先说明分配规则，再解释「断点回归设计」在这个案例里为何可信。

collocations: assumptions of a regression discontinuity design
estimate with a regression discontinuity design

words.enDefinition: The unobserved part of the population outcome left after accounting for the regressors in the model.

examples.en: The regression disturbance in our example includes unmeasured factors that may affect an individual's wages.
examples.zh: 示例中的「回归扰动项」包含可能影响个人工资的未测量因素。
