examples.en: The first treatment cohort contains the fictional schools that began tutoring in the first year.
examples.zh: 第一个「处理批次」包含第一年开始辅导的虚构学校。

examples.en: We estimated a separate effect for each treatment cohort before combining them in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们先为各「处理批次」分别估计效应，再将它们合并。

words.enDefinition: Variation in causal effects across people, groups, places, or times.

examples.en: The class explored treatment effect heterogeneity by comparing simulated course effects across two age groups.
examples.zh: 全班比较模拟课程在两个年龄组的效果，以考察「处理效应异质性」。

examples.en: Treatment effect heterogeneity matters when the average hides different responses across the schools in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，平均值掩盖各学校的不同反应时，「处理效应异质性」就很重要。

words.enDefinition: The part of an economic series attributed to its underlying longer-term movement.

examples.en: The trend component rises gradually even as quarterly output fluctuates in the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 课堂图里，季度产出上下起伏，「趋势成分」仍逐渐上升。

examples.en: We compared the estimated trend component before and after the revisions to the output series.
examples.zh: 我们比较了产出序列修订前后估计得到的「趋势成分」。

words.enDefinition: The underlying rate of growth of a series over time, apart from short-term fluctuations.

examples.en: The graph shows trend growth beneath the quarterly fluctuations in output for the fictional economy.
examples.zh: 图表呈现虚构经济体季度产出波动背后的「趋势增长」。

examples.en: We compared trend growth before and after the change in productivity in our classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂模型中生产率变动前后的「趋势增长」。

words.enDefinition: A strategy that changes a player's future behaviour when a specific event occurs in the game.

examples.en: The model used a trigger strategy that changed the next response after a missed contribution.
examples.zh: 模型采用一种「触发策略」，某次出资未发生后，下一步回应就会改变。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how long the response in the trigger strategy would last in the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，例题里「触发策略」中的回应会持续多久。

collocations: use a trigger strategy in a repeated game

words.enDefinition: An experiment where one player sends an amount that may grow and the recipient chooses how much to return.

examples.en: The trust game gave the second student a choice about returning some of the classroom tokens.
examples.zh: 「信任博弈」让第二名学生决定是否归还部分课堂代币。

examples.en: We recorded the initial transfers and the amounts returned in each round of the trust game.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「信任博弈」每轮最初转交的数量和归还的数量。

collocations: record transfers in a trust game
compare return amounts in a trust game

words.enDefinition: Submitting a bid equal to one's valuation in a model where values are defined for bidders.

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated truthful bidding by matching the number on each offer card to its assigned value.
examples.zh: 练习表把各报价卡上的数字与分配的估值对应起来，说明什么是「如实报价」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed truthful bidding under the private-value assumptions of the second-price auction exercise.
examples.zh: 老师在第二价格拍卖练习的私有价值假设下讨论了「如实报价」。

collocations: compare bids with valuations to detect truthful bidding

words.enDefinition: a price schedule comprising an access fee and a separate charge for each unit used

examples.en: The example's two-part tariff combined a membership fee with a charge for every practice room booking.
examples.zh: 示例的「两部制收费」把一笔会员费与每次练习室预订的使用费组合起来。

examples.en: We compared a two-part tariff with a single per-use charge for the same hypothetical workshop.
examples.zh: 我们把同一个假想工作坊的「两部制收费」和只按次收费作了比较。

collocations: calculate total payment under a two-part tariff

words.enDefinition: An instrumental variable estimator that first projects endogenous regressors on the instruments and controls, then uses the fitted values in the outcome equation.

examples.en: We used two-stage least squares to estimate the simulated tutoring effect under the stated instrument assumptions.
examples.zh: 我们在给定的工具变量假设下，用「两阶段最小二乘法」估计模拟辅导的效果。

examples.en: The tutor showed how two-stage least squares uses predicted participation in the outcome equation.
examples.zh: 老师演示了「两阶段最小二乘法」如何在结果方程中使用预测参与值。

words.enDefinition: A regression specification that includes fixed effects for both units and time periods.

examples.en: The two-way fixed effects model includes separate terms for each school and each year in the sample.
examples.zh: 「双向固定效应」模型分别为样本里的学校和年份设置独立项。

examples.en: We discussed when two-way fixed effects could mix different treatment effects across adoption cohorts in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了练习中「双向固定效应」何时会把不同项目启动批次的处理效应混在一起。

words.enDefinition: A probability distribution over the possible private types of players in a game.

examples.en: The workshop model used a type distribution to represent uncertainty about each group's valuation.
examples.zh: 工作坊模型用「类型概率分布」表示对各组估值的不确定性。

examples.en: We changed the type distribution before recalculating the expected payoffs for the two possible plans.
examples.zh: 我们先改变「类型概率分布」，再重新计算两个可能方案的预期收益。

collocations: draw values from a type distribution
compare outcomes under different type distributions

words.zhGloss: 美国扩展失业指标 U-5
words.enDefinition: the US BLS measure adding all marginally attached people to both total unemployment in the numerator and the civilian labour force in the denominator
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国扩展失业指标 U-5

examples.en: The report compared U-5 with unemployment after including people marginally attached to the labour force in its calculation.
examples.zh: 报告把边缘劳动力纳入计算之后，将「美国扩展失业指标 U-5」与通常的失业率作了比较。

examples.en: Our tutor used U-5 to show how including a group outside the labour force changed the reported rate.
examples.zh: 导师用「美国扩展失业指标 U-5」演示将劳动力之外的一类人口纳入计算如何改变所报比率。

words.enDefinition: the US BLS measure dividing unemployment, marginal attachment and part-time employment for economic reasons by the civilian labour force plus marginal attachment

examples.en: Our worksheet uses U-6 to include workers who want full-time jobs but work part time.
examples.zh: 我们的习题用了「美国广义失业率」，把想做全职工作却只能兼职的人也计入其中。

examples.en: The denominator of U-6 includes the civilian labor force and the marginally attached.
examples.zh: 「美国广义失业率」的分母包括平民劳动力人口和边缘劳动力。

words.enDefinition: A game where one player proposes a division and the other either accepts or triggers disagreement payoffs for both.

examples.en: The ultimatum game asked one student to offer a division of ten classroom tokens to another.
examples.zh: 「最后通牒博弈」要求一名学生向另一名学生提议如何分配十枚课堂代币。

examples.en: We compared how often different offers were accepted in the classroom version of the ultimatum game.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂版「最后通牒博弈」中不同提议被接受的频率。

collocations: analyse offers in an ultimatum game
compare outcomes in an ultimatum game

words.enDefinition: Combination of purchases that costs more than the available spending money

examples.en: An unaffordable bundle lies outside the shaded region because it exceeds the spending limit.
examples.zh: 「不可负担的组合」落在阴影区外，因为它超出了支出上限。

examples.en: How can we spot an unaffordable bundle on the graph without adding both costs?
examples.zh: 我们怎样在不把两项支出相加的情况下，从图上找出「不可负担的组合」？

words.enDefinition: A panel in which the set of observed periods varies across units.

examples.en: The sample becomes an unbalanced panel when two schools have no measured outcomes in one year.
examples.zh: 当两所学校在某年没有实测结果时，样本就变成了「非平衡面板」。

examples.en: We read the notes on the unbalanced panel before comparing estimates across the two classroom exercises.
examples.zh: 比较两个课堂练习的估计前，我们先读了这份「非平衡面板」的说明。

words.enDefinition: a programme payment to eligible recipients without imposing a behavioural requirement as a condition of payment

examples.en: The class evaluated an unconditional cash transfer that had eligibility rules but imposed no behavioural conditions.
examples.zh: 课堂评估了一项设有资格规则、但无行为条件的「无条件现金转移」。

examples.en: We checked how the unconditional cash transfer affected household survey responses in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们检查了假想示例中「无条件现金转移」如何影响家庭问卷答复。

collocations: compare unconditional cash transfers with conditional programmes

words.enDefinition: Employment making less use of available hours or skills than workers want

examples.en: We discussed underemployment when workers wanted more hours than shops were offering.
examples.zh: 当劳动者希望工作更长时间但店家给不出更多工时时，我们讨论了「就业不足」。

examples.en: Our seminar compared underemployment among graduates working in jobs with different skill requirements.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了岗位技能要求不同的毕业生所面临的「就业不足」。

words.enDefinition: In an externality model, production below the quantity that maximizes net social benefits.

examples.en: The model showed underproduction because sellers could not capture the benefits their activity brought to neighbours.
examples.zh: 卖家无法获得活动为邻居带来的收益，因此模型显示出现「生产不足」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed underproduction after comparing the number of training places offered with the efficient quantity.
examples.zh: 老师比较实际提供的培训名额与有效数量后，讨论了「生产不足」。

words.enDefinition: Provision of a public good or service below the quantity that would maximize social net benefits.

examples.en: The model showed underprovision when households contributed too little to pay for the efficient number of lights.
examples.zh: 各家庭出资不足以支付有效数量的路灯时，模型出现了「供给不足」。

examples.en: Our class discussed underprovision after comparing private contributions with the benefits received by all households.
examples.zh: 全班比较个人出资和所有家庭所得收益后，讨论了「供给不足」。

collocations: identify underprovision of a public good

words.enDefinition: Length of the current spell spent without work and classified unemployed

examples.en: The unemployment duration column records how long respondents have been in their current spell.
examples.zh: 「失业持续时间」一栏记录受访者本次失业持续多久。

examples.en: We compared median unemployment duration across respondents with different levels of education.
examples.zh: 我们比较了不同教育程度受访者的「失业持续时间」中位数。

words.enDefinition: Difference between observed unemployment and a benchmark such as its natural rate

examples.en: We calculated the unemployment gap by subtracting the benchmark rate from measured unemployment.
examples.zh: 我们用所测失业率减去基准失业率，求得「失业率缺口」。

examples.en: The model shows a positive unemployment gap when unemployment is above its estimated natural rate.
examples.zh: 模型显示，失业率高于估计的自然失业率时，「失业率缺口」为正。

words.enDefinition: Lasting effects of a temporary increase in unemployment on future joblessness

examples.en: The model links unemployment hysteresis to skills lost during prolonged periods without work.
examples.zh: 模型将「失业迟滞」与长时间无工作导致的技能流失联系起来。

examples.en: We discussed unemployment hysteresis after employment recovered more slowly than spending in the example.
examples.zh: 例子中的就业恢复慢于支出恢复，我们随后讨论了「失业迟滞」。

words.enDefinition: Share of the labor force officially counted as unemployed under the definition

examples.en: We divided the number of unemployed workers by the labor force to calculate the unemployment rate.
examples.zh: 我们用失业人数除以劳动力人口，算出了「失业率」。

examples.en: A fall in the unemployment rate can occur when some jobseekers leave the labor force.
examples.zh: 部分求职者退出劳动力人口时，「失业率」可能下降。

words.enDefinition: A change in one player's strategy while all other players keep their strategies fixed.

examples.en: The worksheet tested a unilateral deviation by switching one club's session while leaving the other unchanged.
examples.zh: 练习表检验一个「单边偏离」，即改变一个社团的时段，另一个保持不变。

examples.en: We considered each unilateral deviation before confirming that the proposed choices formed an equilibrium.
examples.zh: 我们考察了每种「单边偏离」，再确认所提议的选择组合是否构成均衡。

collocations: rule out gains from a unilateral deviation

words.enDefinition: Demand for which purchases and own price change by equal proportions

examples.en: On this curve, unit elastic demand occurs where the elasticity has an absolute value of one.
examples.zh: 这条曲线的弹性绝对值为一的地方，对应的是「单位弹性需求」。

examples.en: With the midpoint method, unit elastic demand between two points implies identical revenues at both.
examples.zh: 按中点法计算，两点之间呈现「单位弹性需求」，意味着两点对应的总收入相同。

words.enDefinition: Supply for which the amount offered and price change by equal proportions

examples.en: In this graph, the straight line through the origin represents unit elastic supply at positive prices.
examples.zh: 这张图中，经过原点的直线在价格为正的部分表示「单位弹性供给」。

examples.en: The example shows unit elastic supply because both variables increased by the same percentage.
examples.zh: 该例说明了「单位弹性供给」，因为两个变量上升的百分比相同。

words.enDefinition: Terms that allow each observed unit to have its own constant baseline in a panel regression.

examples.en: Unit fixed effects absorb stable differences between schools in the classroom example of changes in attendance.
examples.zh: 在课堂出勤变化示例里，「单位固定效应」吸收各学校之间不随时间变化的差异。

examples.en: We included unit fixed effects so the comparison used changes within each fictional school over time.
examples.zh: 我们加入「单位固定效应」，让比较利用各所虚构学校内部随时间的变化。

words.enDefinition: labour compensation per unit of real output, under the source's coverage of output and labour

examples.en: The unit labor cost rose because hourly compensation increased more rapidly than output per hour.
examples.zh: 因为每小时劳动报酬上涨得比每小时产出快，「单位劳动成本」提高了。

examples.en: We divided total compensation by output to calculate unit labor cost in the example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，我们以总劳动报酬除以产量来计算「单位劳动成本」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of labour required to produce one unit of output, typically measured in work hours

examples.en: The unit labour requirement was higher for cloth than for grain in the first classroom economy.
examples.zh: 课堂里的第一个经济体生产布料的「单位产品劳动需求」高于谷物。

examples.en: We lowered the unit labour requirement in the exercise to represent an improvement in production technology.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们调低「单位产品劳动需求」，表示生产技术进步。

words.enDefinition: An unmeasured factor that influences both treatment exposure and the outcome, threatening a causal comparison.

examples.en: The instructor used motivation as a possible unobserved confounder in the example of voluntary tutoring.
examples.zh: 老师在自愿参加辅导的示例中，用积极性举例说明可能的「未观测混杂因素」。

examples.en: We asked whether an unobserved confounder could explain the gap between the two training groups.
examples.zh: 我们问「未观测混杂因素」是否可能解释两个培训组之间的差距。

words.enDefinition: Tendency for prices to rise when buyers compete for limited supply

examples.en: In our simple model, more people seeking the same tickets creates upward pressure on prices.
examples.zh: 在我们的简化模型中，想买同一批票的人变多，带来了「价格上涨压力」。

examples.en: The reading describes upward pressure on prices when grain buyers compete for a smaller harvest.
examples.zh: 阅读材料讲到，买家争购减产的粮食时会出现「价格上涨压力」。

words.enDefinition: A charge paid by those who use a particular facility or service.

examples.en: The example used a user fee to help pay for maintenance of a ticketed recreation facility.
examples.zh: 例题采用「使用者付费」，帮助承担凭票进入的休闲设施的维护成本。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how charging a user fee might change who attended the modelled events.
examples.zh: 老师问，实行「使用者付费」可能怎样改变模型中参加活动的人群。

collocations: fund a service with a user fee
analyse a change in a user fee

words.enDefinition: Rule assigning numbers to bundles to represent a consumer's preference ordering

examples.en: We wrote a utility function to represent Lena's rankings for meals and shows.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「效用函数」，表示莉娜对餐饮和演出组合的排序。

examples.en: A different utility function could give the same rankings to every bundle here.
examples.zh: 在这里，另一个「效用函数」也可以给各个组合排出同样的顺序。

words.enDefinition: Choice of an affordable bundle that gives the highest attainable satisfaction

examples.en: The example uses utility maximization to predict choices under a fixed weekly budget.
examples.zh: 这个例子通过「效用最大化」预测每周预算固定时的选择。

examples.en: We turned the preference table into a small utility maximization problem for practice.
examples.zh: 我们把偏好表改成一道小型的「效用最大化」练习题。

words.enDefinition: the marginal product of an input multiplied by the price of the output it produces

examples.en: The value of marginal product increased when output prices rose and the extra physical output remained the same.
examples.zh: 产成品价格上升而额外实物产量不变时，「边际产量价值」增加了。

examples.en: We multiplied the additional units produced by their market price to find the value of marginal product.
examples.zh: 我们将新增产量乘以市场价格，得出「边际产量价值」。

collocations: calculate the value of marginal product
compare the value of marginal product with wages
derive the value of marginal product

words.enDefinition: an input whose quantity can be adjusted within the time period being analysed

examples.en: Labour hours were a variable input because the stall could adjust them each day in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的摊位每天都能调整人工工时，所以工时是「可变投入要素」。

examples.en: We added one unit of the variable input while keeping the size of the kitchen unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们增加一个单位的「可变投入要素」，厨房面积维持原样。

collocations: choose the amount of a variable input

words.enDefinition: A game in which the total payoff differs across at least two possible outcomes.

examples.en: The exercise became a variable-sum game because both groups gained points when their choices matched.
examples.zh: 两组选择一致时，两组都能得分，因此练习成为「变和博弈」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a variable-sum game with a contest where the same number of tokens was always distributed.
examples.zh: 老师把「变和博弈」与每次都分配同样数量代币的竞赛作了比较。

collocations: distinguish a variable-sum game from a constant-sum one

words.enDefinition: A diagnostic that measures how the correlation of a regressor with other regressors inflates its coefficient's variance.

examples.en: We computed a variance inflation factor for each regressor after noticing that the two schooling measures overlap.
examples.zh: 注意到两个教育指标有重叠后，我们为每个解释变量计算「方差膨胀因子」。

examples.en: The high variance inflation factor indicates that these regressors provide limited distinct variation in our example.
examples.zh: 较高的「方差膨胀因子」表明示例中的这些解释变量能提供的独立变动有限。

words.enDefinition: differences in attributes that buyers rank by quality alike at the same price in the model

examples.en: The example used vertical product differentiation because buyers preferred the longer-lasting material when both versions cost the same.
examples.zh: 示例中买家在两版同价时都更偏好耐用材料，所以采用「纵向产品差异化」。

examples.en: We discussed vertical product differentiation after assigning a clear quality ranking to three versions of the product.
examples.zh: 为产品的三个版本明确划分质量高低后，我们讨论了「纵向产品差异化」。

collocations: rank products in a vertical product differentiation model

words.enDefinition: Adding individuals' marginal willingness to pay at each shared quantity to obtain a public good's aggregate demand.

examples.en: We used vertical summation to add both users' values for the same extra unit of the public good.
examples.zh: 我们用「纵向加总」把两名使用者对同一个公共物品新增单位给出的估值相加。

examples.en: Our tutor drew vertical summation by adding the two values at each quantity on the graph.
examples.zh: 老师把图中各数量处的两个数值加起来，以说明「纵向加总」。

collocations: derive aggregate demand by vertical summation
illustrate vertical summation on a graph

words.enDefinition: A payment or other contribution made by choice to support a shared activity or good.

examples.en: The example modelled a voluntary contribution from each household towards a shared neighbourhood warning service.
examples.zh: 例题将各家庭为社区共享预警服务的「自愿出资」纳入模型。

examples.en: We compared the voluntary contribution in each round with the amount needed to provide the service.
examples.zh: 我们把各轮「自愿出资」与提供这项服务所需的金额作了比较。

collocations: collect voluntary contributions for a shared facility

words.enDefinition: Increase in pay over a specified period, usually expressed as a rate

examples.en: We compared wage growth with inflation to see whether pay gained purchasing power.
examples.zh: 我们将「工资增长」与通胀比较，判断工资购买力是否有所提高。

examples.en: The report compares wage growth across industries with different shares of part-time workers.
examples.zh: 这份报告比较了兼职人员占比不同的行业的「工资增长」。

words.enDefinition: Feedback in which wage increases and price increases repeatedly reinforce each other

examples.en: The model shows a wage-price spiral when wages and prices keep pushing each other higher.
examples.zh: 工资和价格持续相互推升时，模型呈现出「工资价格螺旋」。

examples.en: We discussed whether a single pay increase was evidence of a wage-price spiral.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了一次加薪是否能成为「工资价格螺旋」的证据。

words.enDefinition: A warranty that conveys quality information when reliable producers expect lower costs from offering it.

examples.en: The exercise analysed a warranty as a quality signal because defects would cost the seller money later.
examples.zh: 缺陷会让卖家之后承担费用，练习据此分析了「作为质量信号的质保」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked when a warranty as a quality signal might be convincing to buyers.
examples.zh: 老师问，「作为质量信号的质保」在什么情况下可能令买家信服。

collocations: offer a warranty as a quality signal
interpret a warranty as a quality signal
study a warranty as a quality signal

words.enDefinition: An instrument with too little predictive power for the endogenous regressor to support conventional inference reliably.

examples.en: The hypothetical weak instrument barely changes participation, making the resulting estimates unreliable in the exercise.
examples.zh: 假设的「弱工具变量」几乎不改变参与率，使练习中的估计结果不可靠。

examples.en: We compared the uncertainty from a weak instrument with that from a stronger candidate in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较「弱工具变量」与另一个更强候选变量带来的不确定性。

words.enDefinition: A strategy that does at least as well as each alternative in every case, with some strict advantage.

examples.en: The example showed a weakly dominant strategy because one choice tied in one column and won elsewhere.
examples.zh: 一种选择在一列中打平、其余列都更好，例题以此展示「弱占优策略」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the payoffs tied for the weakly dominant strategy in the small matrix.
examples.zh: 老师问，在这个小矩阵里，「弱占优策略」在哪些情形下的收益与另一策略持平。

collocations: check the ties for a weakly dominant strategy

words.enDefinition: A strategy that an alternative matches or beats in every case and strictly beats in at least one case.

examples.en: A weakly dominated strategy remained tied in one column but gave fewer points in another column.
examples.zh: 一个「被弱支配的策略」在一列里仍能打平，但在另一列得分更少。

examples.en: Our tutor checked both columns before calling the second option a weakly dominated strategy.
examples.zh: 老师核对了两列数值，才把第二个选项称为「被弱支配的策略」。

collocations: compare a weakly dominated strategy with an alternative

words.enDefinition: A least-squares method that gives different observations different weights in the sum of squared residuals.

examples.en: The worksheet uses weighted least squares to give less weight to observations with larger error variances.
examples.zh: 练习用「加权最小二乘法」降低误差方差较大观测值的权重。

examples.en: We compared weighted least squares with an estimation that gives each classroom observation equal weight.
examples.zh: 我们将「加权最小二乘法」与对每个课堂观测值给出相同权重的估计作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Clear rules specifying who may use, control, or transfer a resource.

examples.en: The worksheet assumed well-defined property rights before asking how neighbours might negotiate over access to the path.
examples.zh: 练习表先假定存在「明确界定的产权」，再问邻居如何就小径的使用协商。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why well-defined property rights made the parties' starting positions clearer in the example.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么例题中「明确界定的产权」使各方的初始立场更清楚。

words.enDefinition: Smallest payment someone would take to give up something they hold

examples.en: The survey estimated each seller's willingness to accept for parting with a used bicycle.
examples.zh: 调查估算了每位卖家卖掉二手自行车愿意接受的「最低补偿」。

examples.en: Her willingness to accept was twenty dollars for giving up the ticket she already owned.
examples.zh: 她若放弃自己持有的票，愿意接受的「最低补偿」是二十美元。

words.enDefinition: The tendency of a winning estimate in a common-value auction to overstate value, potentially causing overpayment.

examples.en: The exercise illustrated the winner's curse when the winning estimate exceeded the actual number of tokens.
examples.zh: 获胜估计值超过代币的实际数量时，练习展示了「赢者诅咒」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed why a high initial estimate was associated with the winner's curse in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 老师讨论了为什么课堂模拟中的高初始估计值与「赢者诅咒」有关。

collocations: identify evidence of the winner's curse

words.enDefinition: A transformation that subtracts each unit's mean from its observed values to remove time-invariant unit effects.

examples.en: The within transformation subtracts each school's average from the corresponding observations in the classroom panel.
examples.zh: 「组内变换」从课堂面板中各学校的观测值减去该校平均值。

examples.en: We applied the within transformation before fitting the unit fixed effects model on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习纸上拟合单位固定效应模型前，我们先做了「组内变换」。

words.enDefinition: Changes in a measured variable across observations for the same unit, often over time.

examples.en: The estimate uses within-unit variation in study hours rather than differences between students in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习里的估计利用学习时数的「单位内变动」，不使用学生之间的差异。

examples.en: The graph shows within-unit variation for each school over the four periods in the example.
examples.zh: 图表显示示例中各学校在四期中的「单位内变动」。

words.enDefinition: Population falling within the age range used for a labor statistic

examples.en: The report defines the age range before comparing each country's working-age population.
examples.zh: 报告先说明年龄范围，再比较各国的「劳动年龄人口」。

examples.en: Our exercise uses the working-age population as the base for the participation measure.
examples.zh: 我们的习题用「劳动年龄人口」作为计算参与率的基数。

words.enDefinition: the price of a good on the external market relevant to a trade model or comparison

examples.en: In our small-economy example, the world price stayed fixed when local consumer demand increased.
examples.zh: 在小型经济体的示例里，当地消费需求上涨时，「世界价格」保持不变。

examples.en: We measured the gap between the domestic market price and the world price for the imported good.
examples.zh: 我们衡量了该进口商品的国内市场价格与「世界价格」之差。

collocations: take the world price as given
compare domestic prices with the world price
respond to a change in the world price

words.enDefinition: Percentage change in the price index compared with the same month last year

examples.en: We computed year-over-year inflation for March using the previous March as our comparison month.
examples.zh: 我们使用上年三月为比较月份，计算了今年三月的「同比通胀」。

examples.en: The year-over-year inflation figure can fall as an especially large price rise leaves the comparison.
examples.zh: 此前一次特别大的价格上涨退出比较区间时，「同比通胀」读数可能下降。

words.enDefinition: The assumption that the error term has mean zero at every combination of the included regressors.

examples.en: Zero conditional mean would fail if unmeasured ability systematically differed across schooling levels in our example.
examples.zh: 如果示例中不可观测的能力随受教育年限系统性变化，「零条件均值」就不成立。

examples.en: The tutor stated zero conditional mean before explaining the properties of the estimated coefficients.
examples.zh: 老师先说明「零条件均值」，再解释估计系数的性质。

words.enDefinition: a situation where total revenue exactly covers explicit and implicit economic costs, including normal returns

examples.en: The firm had zero economic profit even though the owner received a return covering her invested resources.
examples.zh: 这家厂商的「经济利润为零」，业主仍获得了足以覆盖自有资源机会成本的回报。

examples.en: Entry stopped at zero economic profit in the simplified long-run model with identical firms and no barriers.
examples.zh: 在厂商相同且无壁垒的简化长期模型中，进入在「经济利润为零」时停止。

collocations: show zero economic profit in equilibrium

words.enDefinition: A game in which the players' payoffs add up to zero at every outcome.

examples.en: In the zero-sum game, any points gained by one team were lost by the other.
examples.zh: 在「零和博弈」中，一队获得多少积分，另一队就失去多少。

examples.en: The tutor asked which feature made the example a zero-sum game regardless of the chosen actions.
examples.zh: 老师问，什么特征使例题无论选择何种行动都属于「零和博弈」。
